- Strong attention to detail

- Comfortable managing or giving feedback to designers

- Organized and able to handle several projects at once

- Able to work independently and follow projects through to completion



Experience with Amazon A+ Content, packaging, website content, or private-label brands is a PLUS. 





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. Your CV and portfolio LINKS showcasing your Amazon creative work.

2. A short text introduction highlighting your relevant experience in leadership and Amazon creatives. No need for AI text-wall write-ups please.

3. Your expected monthly salary (NOT HOURLY) in USD.

title: Video Editor and Content Creator Assistant
description:
Remote | Part-Time (20 Hours/Week) | Flexible Hours | Long-Term Opportunity



JOB OVERVIEW –  

Hi! My name is Mandonnah, and I'm looking for a creative, reliable, and social-media-savvy Video Editor & Content Creator Assistant to become my creative right-hand! I manage social media and create content for multiple clients while also building my own personal brand. I'm looking for someone who can help turn raw footage, photos, and ideas into engaging, polished content. Short-form video editing will be the #1 priority, but I'd love to find someone who can eventually grow into an all-around creative assistant. I'm looking for someone who doesn't just know how to edit videos but understands what makes people want to keep watching!



JOB DETAILS –

- Starting part-time at 20 hours per week, with the goal of growing into a full-time position

- 100% remote with flexible working hours

- No specific U.S. working hours required

- Long-term opportunity with room for growth and increased responsibilities



RESPONSIBILITIES –

- Edit engaging Instagram Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts.

- Assist with long-form videos, podcasts, and vlog-style content.

- Create Canva graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and social media assets.

- Assist with basic photo editing and retouching.

- Research social media trends, sounds, hooks, and creative ideas.

- Help organize footage and repurpose content across platforms.



REQUIREMENTS –

- Previous video editing experience (short-form content is a must).

- Proficiency in at least one editing program (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).

- Familiarity with Canva and social media trends.

- Strong creative instincts and attention to detail.

- Good English communication skills.

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

- Organized, dependable, and comfortable receiving feedback.



Experience with Lightroom, Photoshop, podcasts, or long-form editing is a plus, but not required!



Most importantly, I'm looking for someone who is creative, proactive, eager to learn, and genuinely passionate about content creation.



HOW TO APPLY – To be considered, please
 the following to 



1. Resume:

- An updated resume highlighting your previous work experience and relevant skills.



2. Portfolio:

- At least 2–3 examples of short-form videos you've personally edited.

- Additional graphic design, photo editing, or long-form examples are welcome!



3. Unedited Video Introduction (2 Minutes Maximum). I'd love to get to know the person behind the resume! Please record a short, casual video introducing yourself and sharing:

- A little about yourself and your background.

- What sparked your interest in video editing and content creation.

- What you enjoy most about being creative.

- Why this opportunity interests you.



Please do not edit your introduction video! No fancy equipment, transitions, or effects needed. I'm simply looking to get a genuine sense of your personality, communication style, and enthusiasm!



4. A Few Quick Questions:

- What video editing and design programs do you use?

- How many hours per week are you available?

- Who are two content creators whose editing styles you admire, and why?

- What's one creative skill you'd love to learn or improve?



: 
  

Subject Line: Creative Content Assistant Application – Your Full Name  

IMPORTANT: Applications missing a resume, video editing samples, or an unedited introduction video will not be considered.



ONE LAST THING –  

I'm not looking for someone who knows everything. I'd rather find someone with great creative instincts, a positive attitude, strong communication skills, and a willingness to learn. My goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who can grow alongside me as my business and creative projects expand, ideally transitioning this role into a full-time opportunity as we grow. If you're someone who genuinely loves social media, notices the little details in videos, and gets excited about bringing creative ideas to life, I'd love to hear from you! 😊 I'm excited to find someone I can create and grow with!

title: High-Level Video Ad Editor (AI-specialist)
description:
About Boelou

Boelou is a fast-growing pet brand selling calming pheromone diffusers for dogs and cats. Our products help pets feel safe and relaxed, reducing stress and unwanted behavior like barking, scratching and indoor a
. Our mission is to become the next big brand in the pet industry.



About the role

We’re looking for a video editor to create high-performing ads for Boelou. We start with around 10 hours per week, which gives us the opportunity to evaluate your work. If you perform well, we’ll offer you a fixed number of hours per week.



This is not a beginner role. We work at a high creative standard and we’re looking for someone who can match that level from day one.



Your tools

All AI tool subscriptions and credits (such as Higgsfield) are at your own expense. As a professional AI ad editor, your tools are part of your craft, just like editing software. Already actively working with Higgsfield is a strong plus.



Where this can lead

We see this as an investment on both sides. We start small, but we think big. Boelou has big ambitions, and we’re building a team of editors who grow with us. Editors who prove themselves can grow into guaranteed 40-hour work weeks and earn thousands of euros per month.

You’ll also get access to Hadsway, our AI dashboard. Every week, we review ad performance together at a detailed level, analyzing metrics such as hook rate, hold rate and CTR. The goal is simple: to make you a better editor with every ad you make. We value loyalty, and we invest in the people who stay with us.



What you’ll do

You’ll create high-quality video ads for paid social, including AI-generated ads, cinematic-style ads, and AI talking head videos. Every ad needs to look premium, feel intentional, and be built to perform.



What we’re looking for



Proven experience creating AI ads (AI visuals, AI video, AI talking heads)

Strong skills in cinematic-style editing: pacing, color, sound design, transitions that serve the story

Familiarity with current ad trends on Atria and an understanding of what makes ads perform

A sharp eye for detail. Small mistakes are not acceptable in our ads.

Reliable, communicative, and able to work from a briefing independently



Your setup

Your equipment must be high quality and built for an intensive workload. On average, an ad takes 7 to 10 hours of editing, and your setup should handle these sessions and heavy video files smoothly, without lagging, crashing or slow rendering. Please only apply if your setup meets this standard.



Please note: We are not interested in surface-level edit styles (basic templates, generic captions, stock-footage slideshows). Only apply if you are 100% convinced you can keep up with a high creative standard.



How to apply

We don’t want to see a portfolio. Instead, we want to see the single best AI ad you have ever made. That one ad tells us more than a full portfolio.



Send your application to our inbox with the subject line “EDITOR_APL – [Your Name]”, and include only the following:



Name

Years of experience

Direct link to your best AI ad

 address

WhatsApp number



Important: please send only what we ask for. We receive a large number of applications, and a fixed format allows us to review every applicant quickly and fairly. Applications that include additional information (portfolios, CVs, multiple links, long introductions) will not be considered.



Next step

If you’re selected, you’ll receive an
 from me personally (not through OnlineJobs). This

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
LOCATION Remote, Philippines 

HOURS 40 per week, full-time 

SCHEDULE 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sydney business hours 

CLIENTS Multiple clients and projects



About us

We are a multidisciplinary agency that provides development, marketing, and operations support to businesses across Australia. Our clients come from different industries and business units, and our developers work across several of them at once.



The role

This is a full-time role, but it is not tied to a single client. Your 40 hours each week will be divided across multiple clients, so on any given day you will be working on more than one project, codebase, and set of priorities.



You will work directly with different clients: taking briefs, giving progress updates, and delivering to agreed deadlines. Work follows Sydney business hours, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.



Current projects

• Trade marketplace platform. A B2B marketplace where customers order from multiple suppliers in one checkout. The work centres on supplier integrations (catalogues, pricing, stock, and orders), along with front-end and back-end development as the platform goes live and scales.

• Optometry systems. Software for optometry practices and optical businesses, including practice management systems (PMS), desktop applications, and the integrations and tools around them.

More projects will be added as new clients come on board.



What the work involves

• Building and maintaining integrations with third-party and supplier systems through APIs and webhooks

• Importing and syncing product catalogues, pricing, and stock data between platforms

• Sending and receiving orders and fulfilment status updates between systems

• Handling failed orders and syncs: logging them, retrying them, and alerting the team

• Developing features across the front end and back end of web applications

• Supporting and enhancing practice management systems and desktop applications

• Managing deployments and backend operations

• Documenting each integration and feature so another developer can pick it up

• Communicating progress clearly with clients and the internal team



Skills and experience

• Node.js and Express in a commercial production environment 

• React for front-end development 

• MongoDB 

• Building and consuming REST APIs with JSON 

• Webhooks, including securing and verifying incoming requests 

• OAuth2 and JWT authentication 

• AWS hosting, deployments, and monitoring 

• Git, ideally Bitbucket, with pull request and code review discipline 



Desirable 

• PHP and Laravel 

• Livewire 

• React Native 

• Shopify Admin API and Shopify app development 

• Integrations with supplier, ERP, or inventory systems 

• Order, payment, and invoicing workflows in e-commerce or marketplaces 

• Desktop application development 

• Practice management systems (PMS) or healthcare software 

• Familiarity with Australian GST and tax invoice requirements



The person

• Clear written English. Most communication will be in writing.

• Comfortable switching between clients and projects within the same day, and keeping each one on track.

• Works independently and raises problems early instead of waiting.

• Comfortable reading another company's API documentation and working out what is missing.

• Careful with anything that touches money: orders, payments, credit, and invoices.

• Available to work Sydney business hours, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.



How we will assess candidates

• A review of past integration work, ideally involving orders or payments.

• A short exercise based on a sample API document: explain the flow and identify gaps or risks.

• A short practical coding test covering front-end and back-end tasks.

• A final interview with the team to confirm fit.





• Salary TBD

description:
**About Kingdom Ledger Bookkeeping**

We are a growing, faith-based bookkeeping firm based in Texas, USA, serving small businesses — mainly contractors, trucking, and service companies — across the United States. Our standard is simple: integrity in every number. We are a small, close team looking for the right person to grow with us for the long term, not a short-term gig.



**The role**

You will report to our Senior Bookkeeper and support her on client books in QuickBooks Online:

- Bank and credit card transaction categorization

- Bank and credit card reconciliations

- Job costing — tracking costs and profitability by job, project, and truck

- Invoice entry and payment matching

- Organizing receipts and supporting documents in Google Drive

- Following up on missing client documents

- Keeping your tasks current in Asana as you complete them

- Speaking with clients in virtual meetings when needed, and recording clear end-of-month video summaries of financial statements



**Hours and growth**

- Start: part-time, 5–10 hours per week

- Hours increase based on client needs and the quality of your work — strong performers grow with us toward 15–25+ hours per week and a long-term home here

- Pay: $6/hour, paid biweekly via Wise, always on time



**Who we are looking for**

- 3+ years of bookkeeping experience, including 2+ years working in QuickBooks Online every week (QBO certification is a strong plus)

- **Job costing experience is required** — you know how to track costs against jobs/projects and keep job profitability accurate

- **Trucking industry experience is required** — fuel expenses, per-truck costs, trucking invoicing and paperwork are familiar territory

- Proven reconciliation experience — you can take a messy bank feed and make it tie out

- **You take initiative.** You plan your own week from your task list, you flag problems before you're asked, and you suggest a better way when you see one

- **You are honest and transparent about your work.** We track time in Clockify with clear descriptions of the actual task, and work is logged in Asana the same day it's done. Hours must match completed work — this is a firm standard of our team, and it's how we protect everyone's pay, including yours

- Confident spoken and written English — comfortable talking with US clients in meetings and recording end-of-month statement summaries on video

- Accurate, detail-obsessed, and unembarrassed to say "I don't know — let me find out"

- Reliable computer, stable internet, and backup power — this work cannot stop for outages

- Comfortable working Philippines hours that overlap partly with US Central Time for team check-ins



**How to apply**

Start your application with the word **LEDGER** so we know you read this fully, then answer these three questions briefly:

1. How many years have you worked in QuickBooks Online, and what kinds of businesses were the books for? Include your trucking and job-costing experience.

2. Describe the last reconciliation you completed: which account, how far behind it was, and how you got it to tie out.

3. Why does starting part-time and growing with one company long-term fit what you want right now?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a **short paid trial task** before any offer — we pay for trial work, always.



If you are looking for a stable, long-term seat with a team that values honesty, initiative, and doing things right — we would love to hear from you.

title: Tile Sourcing & Interior Design Specialist
description:
CC & Co. Designs is a Dallas-based residential design firm seeking an experienced tile sourcing specialist to help develop coordinated, budget-conscious tile packages for U.S. homes.



This role is for someone with interior design experience and a strong understanding of U.S. residential bathrooms—including how tile selections work together, how much material a project needs, and how to source products that are available in the U.S.





Responsibilities

- Create coordinated tile packages for bathrooms in new-construction homes.

- Develop options at three tile-material budget levels: $15,000, $20,000, and $25,000.

- Source from our core suppliers: Bedrosians, Floor & Decor, and Riad Tile.

- Select tile for bathroom floors, shower pans, shower walls, and tub surrounds where applicable.

- Calculate quantities, including appropriate waste 10-15% , for typical homes with either 5 full bathrooms and 1 powder room or 4 full bathrooms and 2 powder rooms.

- Account for full-height tile applications, typically 12-foot walls downstairs and 10-foot walls upstairs.

- Verify product names, SKUs, dimensions, pricing, availability, and estimated freight and tax.

- Prepare organized sourcing sheets with product links, quantities, pricing, and suitable substitutions when needed.

- Present selections clearly through mood boards or other visual boards.

This position covers tile materials only. Installation and labor are not included and not necessary.





Qualifications

- Interior design experience with U.S. residential projects.

- Portfolio examples showing bathroom tile selections and coordinated material combinations.

- Experience sourcing tile for U.S. projects and working with U.S. product listings, pricing, dimensions, and availability.

- Strong attention to detail and accurate quantity calculations.

- Able to create clear sourcing schedules and present design choices professionally.

- Comfortable communicating in written English and meeting agreed deadlines.







To Apply

Please send:

1. Your resume and portfolio.

2. Examples of U.S. residential bathrooms you have worked on.

3. One example of a tile sourcing schedule or product list you created, if available.

4. A short explanation of how you would coordinate tile for a bathroom floor, shower pan, and shower walls while staying within a set material budget.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a small paid sample assignment.

title: Experienced Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We're a marketing agency looking for a strategic, creative digital marketer to help our clients grow. This is a marketing role at heart: you'll shape strategy, create content people want to engage with, run social media, and use HubSpot to turn attention into qualified leads.



We want someone who sees the bigger picture. You should be able to look at a business, understand its audience and goals, and d
 which channels, messages, and campaigns will move it forward. Then you'll help bring that plan to life with fresh ideas and consistent execution.



AI should already be part of how you work. We're looking for someone who uses it to research faster, brainstorm better, and produce quality work at scale, while applying their own judgment to everything that goes out the door.



A Note on Fit

This is not a web development or website maintenance role. Our web team handles builds, updates, and technical fixes. We're looking for a marketer who leads with strategy and creativity, someone who d
 what we should say, to whom, and where, and then makes it happen. If your background is mainly in development or site updates, this role likely isn't the right match.



What You'll Do - Marketing Strategy

Get to know each client's business, customers, competitors, and goals.

Build marketing strategies that tie content, social,
, and search together around clear priorities.

Recommend where to focus effort, what can wait, and how we'll measure success.

Present ideas and results to clients with confidence, in plain English.



Content Creation

Develop content ideas and campaigns that reflect each client's brand voice and speak to their audience.

Write and edit blog posts,
s, newsletters, social posts, case studies, and landing page copy.

Brief designers and writers with clear direction, and review their work for quality and consistency.

Repurpose content across channels to get more value from every piece.



Social Media

Create monthly social media content calendars aligned with each client's strategy and campaigns.

Schedule posts across platforms such as LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and X.

Monitor accounts, engage with comments and messages, and flag issues or opportunities quickly.

Track performance and adjust the approach based on what's working.



HubSpot Implementation & Strategy (Go High Level Not Applicable)

Set up and optimize HubSpot for clients, including contacts, lists, segmentation, forms,
s, and workflows.

Design lead nurturing and follow-up sequences that move prospects toward a sale.

Make sure inquiries reach the right person and receive timely follow-up.

Build reports and dashboards that connect marketing activity to leads and revenue.



SEO & AEO

Apply SEO best practices to content, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and internal linking.

Shape content so it can be found and cited by AI-driven search and answer engines (AEO).

Use tools such as Ahrefs, or SE Ranking to find opportunities and track progress.

Work with our web team when technical fixes are needed; you set the direction, they handle the build.



Reporting & AI Workflows

Prepare regular reports that explain what changed, what it means, and what we should do next.

Use AI tools for research, ideation, drafting, and analysis, and check all output before it's shared.

Build reusable templates and workflows that help the whole team work faster and more consistently.



What We're Looking For

Five or more years of digital marketing experience, with campaigns or programs you've owned from strategy through results.

A strategic thinker who can connect marketing activity to business goals and explain the "why" behind recommendations.

A creative mind with strong ideas for content, campaigns, and social media that stand out.

Excellent writing skills and the ability to adapt tone and voice for different brands and audiences.

Experience planning, scheduling, and managing social media including community engagement and performance tracking.

HubSpot experience with workflows, segmentation, forms,
 campaigns, and reporting. HubSpot certifications are a plus.

Solid working knowledge of SEO and a clear understanding of how AI search and answer engines are changing content strategy.

Comfort with GA4, Google Search Console, and at least one SEO platform such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or SE Ranking.

Established AI workflows you can demonstrate and explain, including how you check output for accuracy.

Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to lead conversations with US-based clients.

Experience managing several clients or projects at once. Agency experience is a strong plus.

Good judgment, attention to detail, and a dependable approach to remote work.



Nice to Have

Google Ads experience, including campaign setup, keyword targeting, budget management, and performance optimization.

Familiarity with paid social advertising on LinkedIn or Meta.

Experience with HubSpot Content Hub, Google Tag Manager, or social scheduling tools such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or HubSpot Social.



Schedule & Working Arrangements

This is a remote position based in the Philippines. You'll need consistent availability during US Eastern business hours for team collaboration, client meetings, and timely communication.



We'll agree on the exact schedule before hiring; it will include evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. You'll also need reliable internet, a suitable space for video calls, and backup arrangements for power or connectivity interruptions.



How to Apply

Send your résumé, expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos, and your availability during US Eastern business hours. Please also include:



A marketing strategy or campaign you developed: the business, what you recommended, and the results.

Samples of content you created, such as blog posts,
s, or social media posts.

A social media calendar you built, or an example of an account you managed and how it performed.

An example of HubSpot work you've done, such as a workflow, nurture sequence, or report.

Two examples of how you use AI at work, how you check the output, and what it has improved.

We care most about what you can show us: the ideas you brought, the decisions you made, and what you learned from the results.

title: Printify & Shopify Product Listing VA
description:

You must already know Printify and Shopify. We will train you on our brand requirements and documented processes, but this position does not include training on basic platform use.



About the work



We provide finished print files, documented product guidelines, and access to the tools needed for the job, including ChatGPT and our custom product-description plugin.



You will apply each design to several product types: T-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, tank tops, and hats where the artwork and decoration method are suitable.



The role starts with A or B Tees and may expand to other brands.



Responsibilities



Build products in Printify using our approved blanks, print providers, colors, sizes, and pricing.



Create products in Gelato as required.



Position and resize supplied artwork for the appropriate print areas.



Create or select accurate, appealing product mockups.



Build front-print, back-print, and front-and-back products as instructed.



Manage separate Printify products offered as options within one Shopify listing, preserving correct variant and fulfillment mapping.



Update Shopify product titles, descriptions, pricing, images, and variants.



Use our ChatGPT description plugin, then review the output for accuracy, formatting, and brand voice.



Check artwork placement, mockups, pricing, available options, and fulfillment connections before submitting work.



Save Shopify listings as drafts for approval initially. Independent publishing may follow once quality and reliability are established.



Keep a simple record of completed work and flag questions or production limitations.



Suggest practical improvements to quality and efficiency.



Required experience



Hands-on experience creating apparel products in Printify.



Hands-on experience managing Shopify products and variants.



Experience maintaining correct POD fulfillment connections when combining product options in Shopify.



Ability to explain your process for offering front-print and back-print choices within one Shopify listing.



Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly in English.



Careful attention to artwork placement, product details, and documented instructions.



Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.



Comfortable using ChatGPT and checking AI-generated descriptions.



Preferred experience



Gelato product creation and Shopify integration.



POD apparel catalogs with multiple garment types.



Hat artwork placement and awareness of print or embroidery limitations.



Improving repeatable product-listing processes.



Content requirement



A or B Tees sells products featuring profanity, dark humor, political messages, and adult humor. You must be comfortable working with this content professionally. You do not need to personally agree with the messages.



Schedule and compensation



Ongoing, part-time freelance work.



Flexible working hours; no required U.S. time-zone overlap.



Start as soon as possible.



Initial workload budget: approximately US$300–$400 per month, with hours or deliverables agreed in advance.



Open to hourly pricing or pricing per completed product group.



Additional work may become available as we expand to other brands.



Individual freelancers only; no agencies.



We expect multiple product groups per week. Final production targets will be agreed after a paid trial establishes the time needed to complete the work accurately.



How to apply



Please include:



A brief summary of your Printify, Shopify, and Gelato experience.



Two or three relevant examples of products or stores you have worked on, with an explanation of your contribution. Redacted screenshots are welcome.



Your hourly rate and, if available, your price per completed product group.



Your weekly availability and earliest start date.



Your estimated time to turn one supplied design into four apparel listings plus a hat where suitable. State your assumptions about colors, sizes, mockups, and print locations.



Your explanation of how you would connect two separate Printify products to options within one Shopify listing while ensuring that each order reaches the correct product, size, color, and print placement.



Confirmation that you are comfortable working with the content described above.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid skills test. Please do not create unpaid sample products with your application.

title: Funnel Designer (Remote)
description:
If you’re tired of being treated like a “make-it-pretty” designer — handed random briefs, unclear goals, and last-minute requests with no performance context — this role is built differently.



At Accel Scaling, the Funnel Designer gig is intentionally designed around conversion, clarity, and flow. You won’t just design assets in isolation; you’ll design complete funnel experiences — from first touchpoint to final conversion — with clear intent behind every section, layout, and visual decision.



You’ll work with a fast-moving performance team that respects design as a growth lever, not decoration. Inputs are structured, goals are defined, and your work is measured by how well it supports revenue outcomes — not how many revisions you survive.



This is the role for someone who wants ownership over how funnels look, feel, and convert.



This is a remote gig.



===



Why You’ll Love This Gig:

- Design with purpose. Every page, section, and component has a clear conversion goal.

- Clear context. You’ll know what the funnel is selling, who it’s for, and what action matters most.

- Creative autonomy. You own your design approach and execution. What matters is performance-ready output.

- AI-positive environment. Use tools like Figma AI, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or other AI-assisted workflows — as long as results are accurate, clean, and intentional.

- Skills over credentials. We care about your thinking, your execution, and your results — not paper qualifications.



===



You’re Our Ideal Candidate If...



- You think in flows, journeys, and systems, not just individual pages.

- You understand visual hierarchy as a conversion tool — guiding attention, pacing information, and reducing friction.

- You can translate messaging into clear, structured page layouts that support persuasion.

- You enjoy feedback, iteration, and improving designs based on real-world usage.

- You stay aware of design trends, but prioritize what actually converts.





===



What You Won’t Be Doing



- You won’t manage clients or handle client-facing communication.

- You won’t plan marketing campaigns or manage project timelines.

- You won’t be responsible for long-form copywriting (you’ll work from approved copy / short form placeholders you draft).



===



What You’ll Do

title: Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)
description:
Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: Up to $2,000/month depending on experience, with a clear path to increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Media is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We don't just run ads. We install and run a full growth team for the brands we work with: creative strategy, ad production, Meta media buying, landing pages, and retention, all on a clear weekly creative system. You'll work directly with Matt, ABG Media's CMO and founder (10+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience), and get trained in the systems we use to grow brands.



Our first and current client is a fast-growing supplement brand built on clean ingredients, no fillers, and real results. We're adding more brands. You'll start on that account and edit across more ABG client accounts as we grow. Video ads are a big part of how we grow every brand we work with.



Role Overview

We're looking for a video editor who knows how to turn raw creator footage into Meta ads that sell. Not pretty videos. Ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, and get people to click and buy.



You'll get briefs and scripts from our Creative Strategist, footage from our UGC creators, and performance feedback from our media buyer. But we don't want a button-pusher, and this role is a path to becoming a Creative Strategist. You'll also have real creative freedom: every week you'll pitch and make some of your own ad ideas, and the best ones get real budget behind them. When there's no creator footage, you'll build ads from B-roll, product shots, voiceover, and AI tools. When an ad wins, you'll recut it into more versions so it keeps winning.



We're an AI-forward team. We expect you to use AI tools heavily for research, ideation, production, and iteration: ChatGPT/Claude for research, hooks, and scripts; Midjourney/ChatGPT Images for concept frames; Kling, Runway, or Higgsfield for AI video and B-roll; AI voice and captions to move faster. Human judgment still owns the creative call and compliance.



Career Path: Video Editor to Creative Strategist

This is not a dead-end editing seat. Strong performers whose own ideas win in testing will be trained by the CMO into a Creative Strategist role: owning research, angles, briefs, and the weekly testing plan.



Key Responsibilities



Editing UGC & Direct Response Ads

- Cut creator/UGC footage into 15-60 second Meta ads based on our briefs and scripts.

- Pick the strongest moments from raw footage and pace them so they feel natural and keep attention.

- Add hooks, captions, music, sound effects, product shots, text overlays, and voiceover.

- Write and style native-looking captions (TikTok/Reels style, not overdesigned).



Variations & Sizing

- Create multiple hook/opening variations for each ad (3-5 openings per concept is normal).

- Deliver every ad in 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 for Meta placements.

- Recut and refresh winning ads with new hooks, new footage, new music, or new structures.



Your Own Creative Ideas

- Study competitor ads, the Meta Ad Library, TikTok, and customer reviews to spot hooks, formats, and trends worth stealing (in spirit, not copying).

- Pitch and produce 2-3 of your own concepts each week: your own hook, short script or voiceover, and edit. Run them by the Creative Strategist and they go into testing.

- Take a winning ad and remix it your way: new hook, new structure, new format.



AI & B-Roll Ads

- Build ads from B-roll, stock, product footage, and AI voiceover when no creator footage is available.

- Use AI tools daily (Kling, Runway, Higgsfield for video; ElevenLabs for voice; ChatGPT/Claude for scripts and hook variations) to fill gaps, speed up production, and iterate faster.

- Use AI for research and ideation too: mining reviews, summarizing competitor ads, and generating hook options before you cut.



Workflow & Feedback

- Hit roughly 20-40 finished ads per month (counting variations), depending on complexity.

- Turn around revisions quickly, usually within 24 hours.

- Keep files, project folders, and naming conventions organized so anyone can find any ad.

- Study our top-performing ads to understand why they work, and bring that into your next edits.



Compliance

- No disease claims, no cure or treatment claims, and no exaggerated results in captions, text overlays, or voiceover. If something in the footage crosses that line, flag it or cut it. We'll teach you our rules, but you need to care about following them.



Requirements



Must-Have

- 2+ years editing short-form ads or UGC content, with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads.

- Pro-level skill in Premiere Pro, CapCut (desktop), or DaVinci Resolve.

- Able to deliver 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 versions cleanly.

- Good written and spoken English: you can read a script and understand what it's really trying to say.

- Fast, reliable, and takes feedback well.

- Creative initiative: you have your own ideas for ads and can write a simple hook and short script yourself.

- Comfortable using AI tools every day as part of your workflow (or eager to get there fast).

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work.

- Able to work at least 3-4 hours a day overlapping US Central time.



Nice-to-Have

- Supplement, health, wellness, or beauty brand experience.

- AI tools: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Runway, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, or similar.

- After Effects or basic motion graphics.

- Experience with founder-style, mashup, or voiceover-led ads.

- Basic understanding of Meta ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR).



What We're Looking For

- A storyteller who can find the ad inside raw footage

- Obsessed with the first 3 seconds

- High output without sloppy work

- Owns their work: hits deadlines and communicates early if something is off

- Wants to get better every week based on real performance data



What We Offer

- Competitive pay based on experience, with a clear path to increases as you deliver and as we grow

- Ongoing training in our direct response ad systems

- Work directly with the CMO (10+ years in ecommerce) and our Creative Strategist

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency: start on one brand and add accounts as we sign new clients

- Clear briefs and scripts from a dedicated Creative Strategist

- Creative freedom to pitch and make your own ads, plus real performance feedback so you can see which ones win

- A clear career path into Creative Strategist: strong performers whose ideas win get trained by the CMO into strategy

- Or grow into a Senior Editor / Lead Editor role as we scale

- Remote work with a small, high-standard team



Application Instructions (Please Read)

Start your application with the words "CLEAN CUT" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. A short intro: years of experience, the brands or niches you've edited for, and your editing software.

2. REQUIRED SAMPLE: Links to 3 ads you edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio links; make sure they're viewable). Ads that ran on Meta are preferred. For each one, tell us in one line what you did (full edit, hooks only, captions, etc.).

3. The AI tools you use regularly, if any, and what you use each one for.

4. ONE AD IDEA OF YOUR OWN: for any DTC supplement or wellness product, give us a hook line and a 3-5 line script or shot list for an ad you'd make. Supplement-safe: no disease or cure claims.

5. Share your expected monthly pay (USD) based on your experience.

6. Your time zone and how many hours a day you can overlap with US Central time.



Applications without 3 sample ads and your own ad idea will not be considered. We'll review applications and shortlist within about a week. Finalists will complete a short paid test edit using footage we provide before we make an offer.



HOW TO APPLY: In your application, explain why you're an expert in performance ads. Name the brands or products you've edited for, tell us which of your ads earned real spend and why they worked, and share any results you know. Ads Manager spend screenshots are a plus but not required. Also tell us where you learned your skill and how you keep learning.

title: Junior YouTube Video Editor & Content Assistant — Management Growth Opportunity.
description:
# Junior YouTube Video Editor & Content Assistant

**Long-Term Opportunity | Training Provided | Future Management Position**



**Company:** Let Me Address This (LMAT)  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 2 hours per day  

**Employment:** Part-Time, 10 hours per week  

**Starting Compensation:** $250 USD per month



### About Us



Let Me Address This (LMAT) is a growing American YouTube reaction and commentary channel hosted by Showtime.



Our content includes relationships, dating, comedy, viral videos, social commentary, and entertaining conversations.



We currently publish at least one long-form YouTube video daily and schedule five short-form videos per day across three social media platforms using Publer.



We are building a long-term content production team and looking for our first dedicated assistant.



### Who We're Looking For



We are seeking someone early in their career who already has basic video editing and social media experience but wants to develop their skills.



You do not need to be an expert.



We value reliability, creativity, organization, willingness to learn, and strong communication.



The selected candidate will work directly with Showtime to learn the channel's production process.



Our long-term goal is to develop this person into a trusted YouTube Content Manager who can eventually help train and supervise additional team members.



### Your Responsibilities



**Video Editing**

- Learn and use our existing Descript editing workflow.

- Edit assigned long-form YouTube reaction videos.

- Remove unnecessary pauses and mistakes.

- Add captions, graphics, zooms, and sound effects when appropriate.

- Prepare finished videos for approval.



**Short-Form Content**

- Create engaging Shorts from reaction recordings.

- Add captions, hooks, and vertical formatting.

- Organize clips for distribution across our social platforms.



**Publer & Scheduling**

- Help maintain our existing schedule of five short-form posts per day across three platforms.

- Schedule approved content through Publer.

- Maintain the publishing calendar and check for scheduling errors.

- Prepare approved long-form videos for YouTube publication.



**Content Research**

- Find interesting reaction topics involving relationships, comedy, social commentary, and trending conversations.

- Organize potential reaction videos with links, timestamps, and short descriptions.

- Prepare playlists or compilations of approved videos for Showtime to react to.

- Flag potential copyright or reused-content issues.



**Thumbnails & Optimization**

- Create clickable thumbnails consistent with LMAT branding.

- Help prepare video titles, descriptions, and keywords.

- Learn how to interpret YouTube Studio analytics.



**Organization & Reporting**

- Maintain a content tracker.

- Track assignments and publishing deadlines.

- Submit a brief weekly progress report.

- Communicate clearly when help or clarification is needed.



### Training and Career Growth



This is a long-term position with a structured development plan.



**Months 1–3: Learning and Training**



Work directly with Showtime to learn our editing, scheduling, content research, and publishing systems.



**Months 4–6: Independent Production**



Begin managing assigned production and scheduling tasks with less supervision.



**Months 7–12: Content Operations Development**



Take greater ownership of the content calendar, quality checks, reporting, and production coordination.



**After Approximately 12 Months: Management Review**



We intend to review performance, responsibilities, and compensation for potential advancement to a YouTube Content Manager position.



As the channel grows, there may also be an opportunity to help train and supervise a second assistant.



Raises, additional hours, and promotions will depend on performance, business growth, and available resources. They are not guaranteed.



### Requirements



- Basic experience editing YouTube videos, Shorts, or Reels.

- Familiarity with Descript, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

- Basic Canva or thumbnail design experience.

- Strong written English.

- Reliable internet and computer.

- Ability to work Monday through Friday.

- Willingness to learn Publer and YouTube Studio.

- Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable receiving constructive feedback.

- Interested in long-term professional growth.



### Important



This is a 10-hour-per-week position. The assistant will initially handle selected assignments while Showtime continues managing the remaining production workload.



Responsibilities will expand through training and mutually agreed adjustments to hours and compensation.



### How to Apply



Please answer the following:



1. What video editing software do you currently use?

2. How much experience do you have editing YouTube videos or Shorts?

3. Can you provide two examples of videos you've edited?

4. Have you used Canva, YouTube Studio, or any social media scheduling software?

5. Are you comfortable working Monday through Friday for approximately two hours daily?

6. Are you comfortable with a starting salary of $250 USD per month for 10 hours per week?

7. Why are you interested in growing into a future content management role?



**Please begin your application with "SHOWTIME LMAT".**



Shortlisted applicants will be offered a small paid editing and organization test.



We are looking for someone who wants to learn, improve, and build a long-term working relationship with our channel.

title: Experienced Amazon FBA Item sourcer
description:
# Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant



We are looking for a skilled and experienced Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant to join our team. The primary responsibility of this role is to research and identify profitable products for Amazon FBA through online arbitrage and online wholesalers to provide leads. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Amazon FBA, product research tools, and profit analysis, with a proven ability to find products that meet specific profitability criteria. And is able to reverse source sellers to where the items were purchased from.



## Responsibilities



- Research online retailers and e-commerce websites/wholesalers to identify profitable products to resell on Amazon.

- Identify products with strong demand, competitive pricing, and consistent sales history.

- Analyze Amazon listings, Buy Box prices, sales rank, competition, and price history using tools such as Keepa and SellerAmp, please mention if you already have your sourcing software or would need it provided..

- Calculate potential net profit, ROI, Amazon fees, and shipping costs for each product.

- Find sourcing opportunities that meet our minimum profitability requirements.

- Verify exact product matches, including UPCs, ASINs, variations, sizes, and quantities.

- Identify potential risks, including restricted brands, price fluctuations, excessive competition, and low sales velocity.

- Compile organized sourcing spreadsheets with product links, purchase prices, Amazon listing links, estimated fees, net profit, ROI, and other relevant metrics.

- Monitor price changes and product performance to identify new opportunities and replenishable products.



## Requirements

When submitting your application write the word RED at the end so I know you read my job listing!

- Previous experience with Amazon FBA online arbitrage or retail arbitrage product sourcing.

- Proficiency with Keepa, SellerAmp, or similar Amazon product research tools.

- Strong understanding of Amazon FBA fees, ROI calculations, sales rank, Buy Box pricing, and product restrictions.

- Ability to identify profitable products using accurate data rather than relying solely on price differences.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to research multiple retailers and wholesalers and identify competitive sourcing opportunities.

- Excellent organizational skills and proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver quality results.



## Important Details

Items with low sales and multiple variations are to be avoided.

Profit target minimum 3$ profit per unit, 200+monthly sales, 30% ROI

Grocery items are preferred due to most having no sales tax which eats into margins.

Please provide a spreadsheet of 5-10 items that you have previously sourced.

We are flexible on when the hours are worked you may work during your time zone at any time that is most convenient for you as long as if total hours are met as well as sourcing requirements.

I can also provide a spreadsheet of wholesaler accounts that I already have open if that helps with finding the best items.



- This position focuses exclusively on **finding profitable products to resell on Amazon FBA through online arbitrage and retail/wholesale arbitrage**.

- Candidates must provide accurate calculations and verifiable sourcing links for every recommended product.

- Product recommendations must account for Amazon fees, sourcing costs, shipping, competition, and potential price fluctuations.

- Candidates should prioritize products with consistent demand, healthy profit margins, and manageable competition.



## How to Apply



Please provide a brief overview of your Amazon FBA product sourcing experience, the tools you use and if they must be provided too you, and examples of profitable fba products you have sourced. Include your typical ROI, minimum net profit per unit, and sales per month and experience identifying replenishable products. Applicants to submit 5-10 sample products with retailer links, Amazon ASINs, purchase costs, current selling prices, estimated FBA fees, net profit, ROI, and Keepa history.

We are looking for someone who can consistently identify legitimate, data-backed sourcing opportunities that help our business grow. 



## Flexible Schedule & Growth Opportunities



We offer a flexible work schedule, allowing you to work during hours that best suit your local time zone, provided deadlines are met and communication remains consistent.



We value quality work, consistency, and long-term potential. Candidates who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, and the ability to consistently identify profitable sourcing opportunities may be considered for full-time positions as the business grows. Competitive pay increases and additional opportunities for advancement will be based on work quality, results, and overall contribution to the team.

title: Digital Marketing & Sales Growth Manager
description:
NOW HIRING: Digital Marketing & Sales Growth Manager



** Immediate Start**



Industry: Credit Repair & Financial Services

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long-Term Opportunity



About the Position



Our business is looking for a talented, motivated, and results-driven Digital Marketing & Sales Growth Manager to join our growing team!



We are looking for someone who is highly skilled in digital marketing, social media advertising, AI-powered content creation, lead generation, and sales.



This is more than a social media management position. We want someone who can take initiative, think creatively, and actively contribute to the growth of our business.



The ideal candidate will be responsible for helping us attract new customers, build our online presence, generate qualified leads, and convert those leads into paying clients.



We are looking for someone who is ready to grow with our company. The more value you bring and the better your results, the greater your earning potential.



Job Responsibilities



1.
 & Instagram Advertising



* Create, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

* Develop effective ad strategies specifically designed to generate leads for our credit repair services.

* Research target audiences and identify potential customers.

* Monitor advertising performance, cost per lead, and campaign conversions.

* Continuously test and improve advertisements to maximize results.

* Manage advertising campaigns with the goal of generating consistent, qualified leads.



2. AI Content Creation & Video Marketing



* Create realistic, high-quality AI-generated videos and promotional content.

* Develop engaging videos that promote our credit repair services without requiring the business owner to be on camera.

* Create AI-generated spokesperson videos, voiceovers, promotional videos, and educational content.

* Use AI tools to create professional-looking content that feels natural and authentic.

* Develop creative marketing ideas that attract attention and encourage potential customers to inquire about our services.



3. Social Media Management



* Manage and maintain our company’s social media accounts.

* Create and follow a consistent content calendar.

* Publish approximately 2–3 posts daily.

* Schedule and publish content across
, Instagram, and potentially TikTok.

* Monitor engagement, respond to comments when appropriate, and help grow our online audience.

* Maintain consistent branding and a professional online presence.



4. Lead Management & Sales Conversion



* Serve as the first point of contact for potential customers responding to our advertisements.

* Communicate with incoming leads through approved messaging platforms.

* Follow up with potential customers in a timely and professional manner.

* Educate prospective clients about our services and explain how our credit repair process works.

* Guide interested prospects through the enrollment process.

* Follow up with leads who have not completed registration or payment.

* Help convert interested prospects into paying customers.

* Track lead activity, follow-ups, sales, and conversion rates.



5. Business Growth & Performance



* Provide regular updates on advertising performance and sales results.

* Identify opportunities to increase lead generation and customer acquisition.

* Recommend new marketing strategies and creative campaigns.

* Work toward measurable business growth goals.

* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and consistently look for ways to improve results.



Qualifications & Skills Required



We are looking for someone who has demonstrated experience with:



*
 Ads Manager and Meta advertising campaigns.

* Instagram advertising and social media marketing.

* AI video generation and realistic AI content creation.

* AI spokesperson and avatar video tools.

* Video editing and content creation.

* Social media scheduling and management.

* Lead generation and digital marketing funnels.

* Sales, customer engagement, and closing techniques.

* CRM systems and lead tracking.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication.



Preferred AI Tools: HeyGen, Synthesia, CapCut, Canva, ChatGPT, or similar platforms.



Experience in credit repair, financial services, or the U.S. market is a major plus.



What We’re Looking For



The right person for this position is:



* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

* Creative, resourceful, and knowledgeable about current marketing trends.

* Sales-driven and motivated by results.

* Organized and capable of managing multiple responsibilities.

* Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based customers.

* Reliable, consistent, and interested in a long-term working relationship.

* Someone who doesn’t simply wait for instructions but actively brings ideas to the table.



Compensation & Growth Opportunities



We believe great work deserves great rewards.



Compensation will be discussed with qualified applicants.



We are looking for someone who wants more than just a job. We want someone who is interested in becoming an important part of our company’s growth.



As our business grows, there will be opportunities for increased earning potential based on performance, productivity, lead conversions, and overall contributions to the business.



Hard work, consistency, initiative, and measurable results will be recognized and rewarded.



We want to build a long-term working relationship with someone who is motivated to grow alongside us.



How to Apply



If you believe you have the skills and experience to help grow our company, we would love to hear from you!



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated resume.

2. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

3. Examples of
 or Instagram advertising campaigns you have managed.

4. Samples of AI-generated videos or content you have created.

5. Your experience with lead generation, customer communication, and closing sales.

6. A brief explanation of why you believe you would be a great fit for this position.



We are looking to hire immediately. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.



We look forward to finding someone who can help take our business to the next level!

title: Instagram Account Setup — Paid Per Account (Part-time, Flexible Hours)
description:
We're a US lifestyle brand growing a network of Instagram accounts on remote phones. We need a patient, detail-oriented person to set up new accounts. This is simple, paid-per-account work on your own schedule, not a full-time job.



How pay works:

- $1 for every account you set up. A phone holds 3 accounts, so a full phone is $3 (about an hour of work).

- You log each batch in our team dashboard with a screenshot. It adds up automatically and you're paid weekly.



What you'll do:

- Create new Instagram accounts on our remote phones: sign-up, verification, profile photo and bio from our templates, first login.

- Log every account's details correctly in our team dashboard, every time.

- Hand each finished account to our automated warm-up. You don't post or manage accounts after setup.



What we need:

- Patience: sign-up checks and verifications are a normal part of this job.

- Accuracy: usernames, passwords and recovery details logged with zero mistakes.

- Experience creating social media accounts is a plus.

- A laptop or PC and stable internet.

- 18+.

title: Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist to support a U.S.-based pest control and lawn care business in Florida.



The ideal candidate should have proven experience in creating, managing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, increase customer conversions, and drive measurable business growth.



This is not a traditional social media management or administrative Virtual Assistant role. We are looking for someone who can independently manage advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, analyze marketing performance, develop effective strategies, and take ownership of marketing results.



SHIFT:

 Part time flexible hours and overlap to catch up during US hours





DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Create, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns across
, Instagram, Google Ads, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

- Develop targeted marketing strategies for residential customers, commercial businesses, homeowners associations (HOAs), and golf courses.

- Create and repurpose marketing content for different platforms and target audiences.

- Recommend improvements to landing pages and website content to increase lead generation.

4.
 Marketing & Automation

 marketing campaigns, drip sequences, and customer follow-ups.

 campaigns for commercial businesses, HOAs, and golf course prospects.

title: Bookkeeping / Accounting Associate
description:
About Your Numbers Nerd

Your Numbers Nerd is a Colorado-based bookkeeping and fractional CFO firm. We help small businesses and entrepreneurs build financially stable, sustainable businesses, so they can enjoy more focus, more profits, and more family time. We're a small, close team that works remotely, documents everything, and values integrity, follow-through, and clear communication.



The Role

Bookkeeping Associate 

4-5 hrs per day, M-F 

Remote 

Overlap - at least 2-3hrs of daily overlap with US Mountain time for checkin with team / supervisor 

Pay: $7-10 / hr based on experience, paid in USD 

Reports to: Kisha Johnson, President & Founder 

Start date: Nov 16th or sooner



Summary: You'll handle the daily bookkeeping for our client businesses in QuickBooks Online, following our written SOPs. Your work keeps client books current, accurate, and ready for review, so our clients get timely financials and Kisha can focus on strategy and advisory work.



What You'll Do

Daily transaction management

• Code and categorize income and expense transactions in each client's QuickBooks Online file

• Review and categorize bank and credit card feeds; post deposits

• Collect, file, and match receipts and documents (Hubdoc and similar tools)

• Maintain vendor and customer lists

• Keep each client's chart of accounts aligned to the YNN standard chart of accounts



Month-end and reporting

• Reconcile bank, credit card, and merchant/POS accounts

• Post journal entries with proper support

• Review A/P and unpaid bills, and flag anything that looks off

• Prepare monthly financial statements per our SOPs for Kisha's review 

• Payroll and sales tax support (after training)

• Process client payroll in QBO Payroll on the client's schedule

• Track PTO and prepare sales tax filings per SOP



Team workflow and communication

• Manage your assigned work in ClickUp and update task status daily

• Send a short end-of-day update on what was completed and what's blocked

• Flag questions and exceptions early rather than guessing

• Create Loom videos and written SOP updates when you find a better way to do something

• Communicate with clients and vendors by
 as directed (limited at first, expanding with trust)



What We're Looking For

Required

• 3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience for multiple small-business clients (U.S. clients preferred)

• Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (QBO ProAdvisor certification a plus)

• Solid grasp of accounting fundamentals: reconciliations, accruals vs. cash basis, journal entries, A/P and A/R

• Strong written English: clear, concise, professional

• Reliable, high-speed internet, a dedicated workspace, a personal, up-to-date computer with antivirus and secure, password-protected Wi-Fi, and a backup power/internet plan

• Comfortable recording short Loom/video explanations

• Able to show up consistently during the agreed schedule and overlap window



Nice to have

• Experience with Hubdoc, Dext, or similar receipt tools, ClickUp, Slack, Zoom

• Experience with U.S. sales tax, 1099 tracking, and QBO Payroll

• Experience working directly with a U.S.-based firm or CPA



Traits

• High personal integrity and attention to detail

• Follows the SOP first, then asks before improvising

• Asks questions early, owns mistakes, and communicates proactively

• Self-directed, organized, and dependable without daily oversight

• Enjoys puzzles, problem solving, and finding what's off in the numbers



Tools You'll Use

QuickBooks Online, QBO Payroll, ClickUp, Slack, Zoom, Dropbox, Hubdoc, Microsoft 365 / Outlook, Xennet, Ramp, Claude AI. 

We'll train you on our systems and provide secure access; you'll never be asked to share client credentials outside our approved password manager.



Security requirements

• Signed NDA and confidentiality agreement

• Password manager (1Password or LastPass): you get access only to what you need, admin stays with Kisha, and logins and work are done only by you, with no sharing of access

• Two-factor authentication on all accounts

• A personal, up-to-date computer with antivirus and secure, password-protected Wi-Fi

• A VPN is a plus



How to Apply

Please submit all of the following. 

Applications missing items won't be reviewed. To show you read this posting, include the word "DOLLY" in your application's subject line, and tell us your expected hourly rate for 20-25 hours a week.

1. Your resume

title: Strategic Web Designer, Figma / Website Strategy
description:
Full-Time Remote Role, Philippines-Based

----------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a full-time Strategic Website Designer based in the Philippines.



This role is ideal for someone strong in Figma, who understands website design, and can think strategically about clients, their customers, brand direction, industry patterns, and what makes a website work.



This is not just a production design role. We are looking for someone who can understand the brief, think through the customer journey, research competitors, recommend website direction, and then support that direction in Figma.



Role Overview

-------------------

You will help turn client goals, customer needs, brand direction, website references, and competitor research into a clear internal website strategy and design direction.



You do not need to lead client calls, but you must be able to sit in meetings, understand what clients are saying, extract the important points, and translate that into useful internal notes, design direction, and Figma updates.



You will work closely with our internal team across website strategy, design, and delivery





Key Responsibilities

---------------------------

- Review client briefs, meeting notes, recordings, brand assets, and website references

- Understand what the client wants, what their customers need, and what the website needs to achieve

- Analyse websites the client likes and dislikes

- Research competitor websites and industry patterns

- Identify trust signals, conversion sections, content structure, and visual styles that work in each industry

- Recommend website direction based on customer needs and business goals

- Create look-and-feel concepts in Figma

- Create new website sections in Figma

- Improve layout, spacing, hierarchy, flow, and visual polish

- Update existing Figma designs based on internal direction

- Write clear internal notes explaining design decisions and strategic recommendations

- Keep ClickUp tasks updated with progress, blockers, and time entries

- Communicate clearly with the team via Slack and Google Docs

- Use ChatGPT to support research, summaries, and strategic thinking where useful



What We Are Looking For

-----------------------------------

You should be a mid-to-senior-level website designer with strong strategic thinking.



You should be able to take messy input and turn it into clear website direction.



We are looking for someone who can think before designing.



A strong candidate can say:

“Based on the customer’s needs, the homepage should build trust early, show proof, and make the offer clear, reduce friction, and use a more premium visual direction because the market is crowded.”



A weak candidate only says:

“I can make modern websites in Figma.”



We are looking for the first type.





Required Skills

---------------------

- Strong Figma skills

- Website design experience

- Ability to create new website sections, not just edit existing designs

- Good understanding of layout, spacing, hierarchy, and visual polish

- Ability to create early look-and-feel concepts

- Ability to understand client brands

- Ability to analyse competitor websites

- Ability to understand customer needs and website goals

- Clear written English for internal notes and design rationale

- Good communication in Slack and Google Docs

- Comfortable using ClickUp for task updates and time tracking

- Comfortable using ChatGPT as a thinking and research support tool



English Requirement

-----------------------------

You do not need to be a copywriter or client presenter.



However, you must be able to write clear internal notes, summarise client requirements, explain design decisions, and provide simple website section direction.



Example of the level we need:

“The client wants the site to feel modern, premium, and trustworthy. Their customers are likely comparing providers, so the homepage should quickly communicate credibility, outcomes, and service clarity. The reference websites suggest they prefer clean layouts, strong imagery, and simple navigation.”



Tools You Must Be Comfortable With

----------------------------------------------------

- Figma

- ClickUp

- Slack

- Google Docs

- ChatGPT



Work Hours

-----------------

This is a full-time role.



You must be available to work:

- 9:00 am to 5:30 pm Australian Eastern Standard Time



For candidates in the Philippines, this is usually around:

- 7:00 am to 3:30 pm Philippines time



Please only apply if you can work these hours long-term.



Role Structure

-------------------

- Full-time remote contractor role

- Philippines-based candidates only

- 3-month probation period

- If successful after probation, the role continues on the same agreed monthly salary

- 1 week's notice during probation

- 2 weeks' notice after probation

- Unpaid leave only

- Contractor must provide their own laptop, stable internet, and suitable work setup

- This is a fully exclusive role. You must not work with other clients while engaged in this role

- Daily time tracking is required in ClickUp

- No screenshots or activity monitoring required

- Confidentiality and IP ownership agreement required



Access and Confidentiality

------------------------------------

You will have access to internal documentation, project files, client information, Figma files, brand assets, and other materials required to do the role well.



All work created during the role, including strategy notes, design concepts, Figma files, website layouts, written documentation, research outputs, and related assets, will be owned by the company.



You may not share client work publicly, use it in a portfolio, or reuse it elsewhere without written approval.





Who This Role Is Not For

---------------------------------

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to follow the exact design instructions

- You are not comfortable thinking strategically

- You cannot explain your design decisions

- You do not like researching competitors or industries

- You only want production design tasks

- You cannot work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

- You are currently working with other clients and want to keep doing so

- You are not comfortable with ClickUp time tracking





How To Apply

--------------------

Submit your application to 



Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your Figma portfolio or links to website design work

3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

4. Confirmation that you can work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

5. Confirmation that you are available for a full-time exclusive role

6. A short answer to this question:



“Tell us about a website you designed or improved. What was the client trying to achieve, and who was the

customer, and why did you choose that design direction?”



Applications that only say “I am interested” without answering the above will not be considered

title: Senior Paralegal / Senior Legal Assistant – Civil Litigation or Intellectual Property
description:
**About the Role**



The Law Office of Herbert T. Patty is seeking an experienced Senior Paralegal or Senior Legal Assistant with a strong background in civil litigation or intellectual property.



This is a senior role requiring someone who can independently manage substantive legal support work, anticipate case needs, take ownership of deadlines, and deliver accurate, well-organized work with minimal supervision. All substantive legal work will remain subject to attorney review and direction.



Experience in either civil litigation or intellectual property is required. Experience in both is an advantage.



**Key Responsibilities**



- Take ownership of assigned matters’ legal support workflows, documentation, deadlines, and follow-ups.

- Prepare and review drafts of legal documents, correspondence, and supporting materials for attorney approval.

- Conduct legal and factual research and provide clear, concise summaries.

- Maintain accurate case calendars and proactively monitor filing deadlines and procedural requirements.

- Organize and review case files, identify missing information, and follow up to keep matters moving.

- Coordinate with clients, courts, opposing counsel, vendors, and other parties as directed.

- Provide concise status updates and promptly flag risks, delays, or decisions requiring attorney attention.

- Review work for accuracy, completeness, formatting, and compliance with applicable requirements before attorney review.

- Help improve legal support procedures and provide guidance to junior support staff when needed.

- Perform additional related duties based on case requirements and the evolving needs of the role.



**Practice-Specific Responsibilities**



Responsibilities will depend on your area of expertise and assigned matters.



**Civil Litigation**



- Draft pleadings, motions, discovery requests and responses, and other litigation documents for attorney review.

- Coordinate document collection, review, and production.

- Prepare exhibits, chronologies, deposition materials, and hearing or trial preparation files.

- Coordinate court filings and service, verify filing acceptance, and maintain supporting records.

- Track case activity and applicable court rules and deadlines.



**Intellectual Property**



- Support patent, trademark, and/or copyright matters within your area of experience.

- Prepare application materials, filings, and correspondence for attorney review.

- Maintain accurate intellectual property portfolios and docketing records.

- Monitor application status, official correspondence, and upcoming deadlines.

- Assist with responses, renewals, maintenance filings, and supporting research as applicable.



**Required Qualifications**



- Substantial experience as a paralegal or legal assistant, including senior-level responsibility in civil litigation or intellectual property.

- Experience supporting a U.S. legal practice and familiarity with the procedures relevant to your practice area.

- Demonstrated ability to manage substantive assignments from initial instruction through completion with minimal supervision.

- Strong legal research, drafting, proofreading, and document preparation skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication.

- Strong deadline management, organization, and attention to detail.

- Ability to anticipate next steps, identify problems, and exercise sound judgment about when to escalate.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, PDF editing tools, legal research platforms, and relevant case management or filing systems.

- Professional discretion when handling confidential and privileged information.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work setup.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience supporting a US law practice.

- A degree in law, legal studies, or a related field, or a paralegal qualification.

- Experience in both civil litigation and intellectual property.

- Experience reviewing junior staff work or improving legal support processes.



**Work Arrangement and Compensation**



- Remote position.

- Weekly hours, schedule, required availability during Pacific Time, and anticipated start date will be discussed during the interview.



**How to Apply**



Please submit:



- Your updated résumé.

- A summary of your senior-level civil litigation and/or intellectual property experience, including the jurisdictions you have supported.

- Examples of substantive responsibilities you have managed independently.

- The legal research platforms, case management tools, and filing systems you have used.

- Your availability, and earliest possible start date.



Please use **“Senior Paralegal / Legal Assistant – [Your Name]”** as your application subject line.
