title: AI Video Editor
description:
KIN Super Supps was born from a simple idea: our dogs deserve better. Better ingredients, better science, and better support, especially as they age.



We launched our first line of advanced functional supplements in the US earlier this year and we're growing fast - dogs doing well, owners recommending us to their friends, and more dog parents finding us every week. Every formula is science-backed, transparently made, and crafted with the same care we'd want for our own dogs.



We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own the video creative that tells our story. You'll generate, edit, and stitch together AI-powered videos - UGC-style ads, animations, product explainers, and short-form social content - using tools like Higgsfield and ElevenLabs alongside traditional editing.



We're looking for someone who is obsessed with what AI video can do right now, has the taste to make it look and sound real, and cares about dogs enough to tell their stories well. You'll own your output, have the freedom to experiment with new tools and formats, and grow as fast as your work does.



As an early stage brand, we're building our creative engine from the ground up. That means real opportunity to shape how KIN looks and moves on screen - not just the videos you make, but the workflows and systems behind them.





You'll Love This Role If:



• You're always testing the newest AI video tools. You know what dropped this week, what it's good at, and where it still breaks. You'd happily spend an evening figuring out how to make a generated dog's fur move naturally.

• You genuinely love dogs. Most of our videos are about dogs, their health, and the people who love them. If you notice when a dog's walk looks wrong, you're already ahead.

• You like owning something and running with it, instead of waiting to be told what to do next.

• You care about work that's actually good, not just getting it out the door. You can tell when AI footage feels off, and you don't ship it until it doesn't.





Responsibilities



You'll produce video across three areas, all feeding the same goal: video that sells. You'll work with our media buyer, copywriters, and marketing lead to turn briefs into finished creative and learn from what performs.



1. AI UGC and ad creative

• Generate realistic UGC-style videos with AI avatars, talking heads, and dog footage, using Higgsfield and similar tools

• Produce voiceovers and character voices in ElevenLabs that sound like real dog parents, not robots

• Turn one script into multiple hooks, angles, and variations so our media buyer always has fresh creative to test



2. Animation and explainers

• Create animated product explainers that make our ingredients and science easy to understand

• Build motion graphics, text overlays, and visual storytelling that stay on brand



3. Editing and stitching

• Stitch AI-generated clips, stock, and real footage into seamless, polished videos

• Use GPT-6 Astra and other AI assistants to speed up scripting, shot lists, prompting, and repetitive editing work

• Edit, caption, and format videos for Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and our website

• Build and document repeatable workflows so we can produce more, faster, without dropping quality





Requirements



Experience

• A portfolio of AI video work that speaks for itself

• Hands-on experience creating AI-generated video, either for a brand, an agency, or your own projects

• Strong, hands-on with these AI tools:

   - Higgsfield for AI video generation, UGC avatars, and animation

   - ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers and character voices

   - GPT-6 Astra for scripting, shot lists, prompting, and automating parts of the edit

   - Other AI video and image generators as needed, to stitch clips into one seamless video



Skills

The right person for this role must have these skills:



• AI video generation. You're strong in Higgsfield and comfortable with other generators. You know how to prompt for consistency across shots, fix the uncanny moments, and get usable footage fast.

• AI voice and audio. You're strong in ElevenLabs. You can direct a voice for tone, pacing, and emotion, and mix it cleanly with music and sound.

• AI-assisted workflow. You use GPT-6 Astra (or similar) to plan, script, prompt, and automate parts of your editing, so you ship more without cutting corners.

• Editing and storytelling. You can stitch clips into a video with a strong hook, clear pacing, and a reason to keep watching. You understand what makes short-form ads and social videos work.

• Product and audience understanding. You can pick up what dog parents worry about and how our supplements help, so your videos feel real to them. We've done a lot of the groundwork already, so a big part of this is learning it quickly.





Results



Success in this role is measured by:



Creative performance

Your videos win. Ads you make hit strong hook rates, watch time, and ROAS, and more of our winning ads come from your work month on month. You work with the media buyer to learn what's working and build on it.



Output and workflow

You ship a steady flow of finished videos and variations every week and hit your deadlines. You work smoothly with our copywriters, media buyer, and marketing lead, take feedback well, and turn it around quickly.



Representing KIN well

Everything you put out looks and sounds like KIN. AI footage that feels real, dogs that move like dogs, and a brand dog parents trust.





What's In It For You



• Work at the frontier of AI video. You'll use the newest tools on real campaigns with real spend behind them, and see exactly how your work performs.

• Do work you can be excited about, if you love dogs. You'll help dogs live healthier, more comfortable lives, and help the people who love them do right by them.

• Freedom to experiment with new tools, formats, and styles, alongside an experienced marketing team you'll learn a lot from.

• A small team that trusts you to do great work. No approval chains, no micro-management. You'll be supported by seniors and peers, but you own your craft and your output.

• Performance bonuses tied to measurable results, with growth structures in place as your creative wins.

• A clear path into a creative or video lead role as we grow.





Key Questions For Candidates



To help us understand your expertise and fit for this role, please answer the following questions thoughtfully and honestly. Feel free to share examples that best show your potential and passion for the craft.



1. If you're a dog parent, tell us about your dog (or dogs). If you're not, tell us why you love dogs.



2. Share 2-3 AI videos you've made that you're proud of. For each, tell us which tools you used, how you made it, and what you'd improve.



3. Walk us through how you'd make a 30-second UGC-style ad for a dog joint supplement, from script to final export, using Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and anything else you'd reach for.



4. What's one AI video tool or technique you've picked up in the last month, and what did it change about how you work?



*Portfolio required. Applications without links to AI video work won't be considered.

s with US clients

title: Bilingual HR & Recruitment Specialist
description:
We are looking for a self-driven, bilingual HR professional to build our construction recruitment pipeline from the ground up.  who is fit to work on our Nashville job sites.

1. Build the recruitment system

 and messaging templates).

 Jobs, Craigslist),

• Track where applicants come from and focus effort on the channels that work best.

• Review resumes, work history, trade experience, certifications, and references.

• Assess trade skills, safety knowledge, reliability, and availability for job sites.

• Use standard interview questions and scorecards so every candidate is judged fairly.

• Arrange practical skill checks with site supervisors when needed.

4. Background checks and compliance

• Run background checks, reference checks, and certification checks (e.g. OSHA 10/30, trade licenses) through approved remote providers.

• Follow US hiring rules, including written consent for background checks (FCRA), equal-opportunity and anti-discrimination rules, and confirmation of legal work authorization (Form I-9 / E-Verify).

• Keep applicant information secure and confidential.

5. Make hiring decisions and onboard

• D
 which candidates are fit to work on Nashville job sites, based on skills, checks, and site needs.

• Send job offers and rejection notices in a professional and timely way.

• Coordinate onboarding: paperwork, start dates, safety orientation, and site assignment.

• Keep a ready pool of pre-screened workers for upcoming projects.

6. Reporting

• Send weekly reports on applicants received, interviews done, hires made, and open positions.

• Suggest improvements to make hiring faster and more reliable.



Qualifications

Required

• Fluent in English and Spanish, spoken and written.

• At least 2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, or staffing, ideally high-volume or blue-collar hiring.

• Experience screening resumes, interviewing candidates, and making hiring recommendations or decisions.

• Basic knowledge of US hiring rules (background check consent, equal opportunity, work authorization).

• Comfortable working remotely with video calls, spreadsheets, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and online forms.

• Able to work during US Central Time business hours, with flexibility for early or evening calls.

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.



Preferred

• Familiarity with trade roles (carpenters, electricians, plumbers, welders, masons, equipment operators, general laborers) and certifications such as OSHA 10/30.

• Experience setting up an applicant tracking system or recruiting process from scratch.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field.

• Knowledge of the Nashville or Tennessee labor market.



Key skills



• Organized and detail-oriented; keeps accurate applicant records.

• Clear, friendly communicator who builds trust with workers.

• Sound judgment and fairness when d
 who is fit for the job.

• Self-starter who can work independently with little supervision.

• Handles confidential information with care.

title: AI Avatar Video Creator (Hyper-Realistic AI UGC)
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI video creator who specializes in generating ultra-realistic AI avatars that can naturally deliver spoken scripts on camera.



Our goal is to create AI-generated videos that look and sound as close to real human recordings as possible.



We are NOT looking for basic AI avatars with robotic voices, unnatural facial expressions, or obvious AI-generated movements.



What We're Looking For



We need someone who can take a script we provide and turn it into a highly realistic video featuring an AI-generated person speaking directly to the camera.



The final result should look like an authentic video recorded by a real person, not a typical AI-generated advertisement.



Requirements



Photorealistic AI Avatars: Generate realistic human characters with natural facial expressions, skin textures, eye movements, and subtle body language.



Accurate Lip-Syncing: Mouth movements must align naturally with the spoken words, without noticeable glitches or unnatural expressions.



Natural Voice Delivery: Realistic speech with appropriate pacing, emotion, pauses, and vocal inflections. No robotic or monotone delivery.



Realistic Human Movement: Natural blinking, head movements, gestures, and facial expressions that match the dialogue.



Authentic Video Appearance: Videos should resemble genuine iPhone recordings, interviews, podcasts, testimonials, or casual conversations rather than polished AI demonstrations.



Character Consistency: Maintain the same character's appearance and voice throughout longer scripts and multiple scenes.



Attention to Detail: Identify and correct common AI imperfections, including distorted facial features, unnatural movements, poor lip-syncing, and inconsistent lighting.



Tools & Software



You must have access to your own AI video generation tools and software.



We will NOT be providing subscriptions, software licenses, or access to AI generation platforms.



You are expected to have the necessary tools, subscriptions, and technical expertise to produce professional-quality AI avatar videos independently.



Experience with platforms such as HeyGen, Kling, Veo, Runway, Hedra, or other advanced AI video generation tools is preferred.



We care much more about the quality and realism of your final output than which tools you use.



What We Will Provide



Complete scripts



Character descriptions and visual references



Desired video style and setting



Creative direction and examples



Your responsibility will be to generate a convincing AI character delivering the script naturally and realistically using your own tools and resources.



Important



The biggest factor we will evaluate is realism.



We want viewers to feel like they're watching a real person talking, not an AI avatar reading a script.



If your work contains obvious AI artifacts, unnatural lip-syncing, robotic voices, or stiff facial expressions, it will not meet our requirements.



How to Apply



Please include:



Examples of your most realistic AI-generated talking-head videos.



The AI tools you currently use and have access to.



Your experience generating longer videos with consistent characters.



Applicants who can demonstrate exceptional realism will be prioritized.



We are looking for someone reliable who can consistently produce high-quality work for an ongoing working relationship.

Share an example of a fully complex automation system that you built out with AI that is similar to what i'm describing



Start your proposal with the word "Desk" so we know you read the whole post.

title: Mechanical / HVAC Design Engineer – Australian Projects – Flexible Engagement
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are Noppen Air Pty Ltd, an Australian commercial HVAC contractor looking for a Philippines-based mechanical engineer to support our Australian projects. You will personally carry out HVAC engineering and produce the drawings and technical information needed to price and deliver commercial HVAC replacement, refurbishment and design-and-construct projects.



Our projects include air-conditioning and ventilation upgrades in churches, libraries, community facilities and commercial buildings. You should be comfortable developing an initial brief or consultant concept into a practical solution, as well as reviewing and updating an existing design.



We already work with team members in the Philippines. We welcome experienced engineers looking for ongoing work or individual projects.



We are open to part-time, full-time or project-based arrangements. Please tell us which arrangement suits you, your availability, and the hours you could commit. For ongoing roles, we would agree on suitable overlap with our Sydney team.



Rates are negotiable based on experience and scope. Please provide your preferred arrangement and hourly/monthly rate, or explain how you price individual projects.



You will work with our Australian project, installation and estimating team. We can arrange site photographs, measurements and client or supplier clarifications. You will help turn the available project information into a practical design and identify any additional information needed to complete it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Review client briefs, tender scopes, consultant concepts, existing drawings, site information and equipment selections. Validate the proposed solution and develop alternatives where equipment is obsolete, unavailable or unsuitable for the site.

- Carry out heating/cooling load and ventilation calculations, equipment selection, duct sizing, airflow and static-pressure checks, and refrigerant/condensate pipework design using manufacturer requirements and selection tools.

- Design and document VRF/VRV, ducted split and packaged air-conditioning systems, heat-recovery/outside-air ventilation, fans, grilles, diffusers and associated ductwork and piping.

- Produce practical plant and services layouts that address equipment clearances, maintenance access, available space, routes and penetrations, using site measurements and surveys supplied by our Australian team.

- Prepare tender-stage drawings, equipment schedules, quantity take-offs and clear technical scopes so our team can obtain comparable supplier and subcontractor quotations and complete the tender price.

- Review supplier selections and quotations against the drawings and scope, checking capacities, quantities, accessories, inclusions and exclusions, and flag missing or duplicated items.

- Develop coordinated AutoCAD design and shop/workshop drawings, schematics and schedules for installation; respond to technical RFIs and update drawings as the project develops.

- Define mechanical controls requirements, operating sequences and BMS interfaces, including relevant VAV, economy-cycle and heat-recovery functions, in coordination with the controls specialist.

- Identify assumptions, scope gaps and technical questions, and coordinate electrical loads/switchboards, structural supports, drainage, fire interfaces, acoustic requirements and builder's works with the relevant specialists.

- Support commissioning documentation, as-built drawings and O&M manuals using site records and test results provided by our Australian team. Coordinate technical reviews and certification inputs with Australian consultants where required.

- Keep calculations, source files and drawing revisions organised, and communicate clearly about progress and delivery dates.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- A mechanical engineering qualification and practical experience designing commercial HVAC replacement/refurbishment and design-and-construct projects.

- Experience delivering work for Australian projects and familiarity with the Australian standards and project requirements relevant to your designs.

- Ability to personally perform engineering calculations and produce both tender/design drawings and coordinated shop/workshop drawings.

- Practical experience with VRF/VRV, ducted split or packaged systems, heat-recovery ventilation, air distribution, refrigerant piping and condensate drainage.

- Ability to prepare quantities and technical information for estimating, and check supplier selections and quotations against the design.

- Strong AutoCAD skills and experience with HVAC calculation tools such as Carrier HAP, Camel or equivalent.

- Clear written and spoken English and the ability to coordinate remotely with an Australian team.

- Availability consistent with agreed hours or project scope, and the ability to agree realistic deadlines and meet them.



Additional advantages include chilled-water and condenser-water systems, cooling towers, pump/VSD upgrades, kitchen exhaust and Revit/BIM. More extensive BMS design, points schedules or controls programming experience is welcome; please explain your level of involvement. You will coordinate with specialist contractors for their trade designs and site works.



Current Australian engineering registrations and experience preparing Australian design/compliance certificates are additional advantages. Please distinguish work you can personally certify from design work you prepare for review and certification by another engineer.



An early assignment may involve tender-stage engineering for an existing Sydney retail site's cooling towers, pump VSDs and kitchen exhaust upgrades. We have a technical information package available for suitable candidates to review.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your CV and a short description of your most relevant Australian HVAC projects, explaining your personal role.

2. Two anonymised examples of engineering calculations and drawings you are permitted to share. Tell us which parts you produced yourself.

3. Your experience with VRF/VRV, ducted split/packaged systems, heat-recovery ventilation and commercial HVAC refurbishments. Also mention any cooling-tower, chilled/condenser-water, pump/VSD or BMS experience, distinguishing controls design/interface work from programming.

4. The design and drafting software you use.

5. Your preferred engagement type, available hours, hourly/monthly rate and currency (or approach to pricing individual projects), and earliest start date.

6. Any existing commitments that would affect your agreed availability or project delivery.

7. List any Australian engineering registrations or credentials you hold (e.g. NSW Professional Engineer/Design Practitioner, CPEng, NER or RPEQ), with disciplines and registration numbers. Explain which design/compliance certificates you can personally issue for NSW HVAC projects, with an example if available. If another engineer certifies your work, explain the arrangement. If you are working towards Australian registration, state the pathway and current stage. Please clearly distinguish credentials held from registrations you are pursuing.



Shortlisted candidates will have a technical interview. Where useful, we may agree a paid practical assignment with a defined scope and fee as part of the selection process.

title: SENIOR AI ENGINEER & AUTOMATION ARCHITECT/App Development
description:
Att: SENIOR AI ENGINEERS / AUTOMATION ARCHITECT and App Developers 



Open position to Build Real Solutions. Lead Innovation. Develop Your Own Team. Get Rewarded for Results.



Company: Keyprime Inc. | Minnesota, USA

Employment: Full-Time | Long-Term

Monthly Salary: $1,800–$2,500 USD

Additional Milestone Compensation: $50–$250 / Project 

Schedule: Flexible Hours | 40 Hours Weekly



Are you an experienced software engineer or app developer who enjoys solving complex business problems, building intelligent applications, and developing automation systems that make a measurable difference?

Do you have the ambition to eventually build and lead your own engineering team?

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer & Automation Architect to help establish and grow our company’s internal AI and automation capabilities.

We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned development tasks.

We want a technically skilled, independent, forward-thinking professional who can identify business inefficiencies, recommend solutions, and build reliable technology that transforms how our company operates.



You will work directly with Owners & Lead Mannagment  and collaborate with department leaders, and take ownership of projects from concept through implementation.

This is an opportunity to become the founding technical leader of a growing internal engineering function.

Your ideas will be heard. Your work will make a measurable impact. Your results will be recognized and rewarded.



WHY JOIN?



1. OPPORTUNITY TO BUILD AND LEAD YOUR OWN TEAM

Our long-term vision extends beyond hiring one engineer.

We intend to establish an internal AI development and business automation department.

Initially, you will independently design, develop, and implement applications, integrations, and automation systems.

As our technology initiatives expand, you may have opportunities to:

* Help establish and lead our engineering department.

* Recommend and recruit additional developers.

* Interview and evaluate technical candidates.

* Mentor and manage future engineering team members.

* Establish software development standards.

* Lead increasingly complex development projects.

* Help shape the company’s long-term technology strategy.



Following the initial 90-day evaluation, we may consider expanding the engineering team based on demonstrated results, project demand, and company needs.

We are looking for someone with the technical expertise and leadership potential to grow alongside our organization.



2. FLEXIBLE WORKING HOURS

We believe exceptional engineers should be evaluated by the quality of their work and the results they deliver.

You will have flexibility to organize your working hours while maintaining full-time availability and meeting agreed project commitments.

Some scheduled overlap with U.S. Central Time will be required for departmental meetings, employee interviews, and collaboration.

Outside those commitments, you will have the freedom to manage your development schedule.



3. DIRECT ACCESS TO COMPANY LEADERSHIP

Your recommendations will be heard, decisions can be made efficiently, and you will have opportunities to influence the company’s technology strategy.

We value professionals who think independently, identify problems, and take initiative.



4. COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION AND PROJECT BONUSES

Monthly Base Salary: $1,800–$2,500 USD

Compensation will depend on technical experience, demonstrated capabilities, communication skills, and leadership potential.

In addition to your base salary, qualifying development milestones may earn performance bonuses.

Bonuses are based on successful delivery, functionality, reliability, documentation, and demonstrated business value.



5. 90-DAY PERFORMANCE AND COMPENSATION REVIEW

After your first 90 days, we will evaluate your:

* Technical performance and completed projects.

* Quality and reliability of developed applications.

* Independent problem-solving abilities.

* Communication and collaboration.

* Leadership capabilities.

* Contributions to operational efficiency.

* Ability to establish and execute a development roadmap.

This review may lead to increased compensation, expanded responsibilities, and opportunities to develop an engineering team.



6. PROFESSIONAL INDEPENDENCE AND CREATIVE FREEDOM

You will have the opportunity to recommend technologies, design software architecture, develop custom applications, and manage projects from concept through deployment.

We encourage innovation, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

We want someone who takes pride in building systems that work reliably and deliver measurable value.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

Keyprime operates multiple business departments, including production, sales, estimating, accounting, and administration.

Our objective is to develop intelligent applications and automated workflows that connect these departments, reduce manual work, and improve operational efficiency.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

We are seeking a senior-level engineer with strong experience in:

* Python.

* JavaScript or TypeScript.

* Full-stack web application development.

* REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

* SQL and database architecture.

* AI model APIs and application integration.

* AI-powered business applications.

* Business process automation.

* n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar platforms.

* Cloud application deployment.

* Software architecture and system design.

* Authentication and data security.

* Application testing, debugging, and documentation.



Experience with React, Node.js, Google Apps Script, OCR, document intelligence, and accounting integrations is advantageous.



We prefer candidates with at least five years of professional software development experience, including demonstrated AI integration or automation projects.

Equivalent demonstrated expertise will be considered.

You must be capable of independently developing complete software applications and not simply configuring no-code automation tools.



LEADERSHIP QUALIFICATIONS

Because this position has the potential to develop into an engineering leadership role, we are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

* Strong technical decision-making.

* Independent project ownership.

* Ability to establish development priorities.

* Experience mentoring or leading developers.

* Ability to evaluate technical talent.

* Strong organizational and planning skills.

* Ability to communicate with nontechnical employees.

* Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions.

* Professional integrity and accountability.

* Long-term commitment to organizational growth.



Previous engineering team leadership experience is preferred but not mandatory.

We value candidates who demonstrate the ability and ambition to grow into leadership.



EXCELLENT ENGLISH COMMUNICATION IS MANDATORY

This position requires frequent communication with U.S.-based employees and company leadership.

You must possess excellent spoken and written English.



Your responsibilities will include:

* Interviewing employees to understand their responsibilities.

* Identifying operational problems.

* Asking clear and relevant questions.

* Explaining technical solutions in understandable language.

* Presenting project plans and progress.

* Conducting software demonstrations.

* Training employees.

* Communicating directly with company leadership.



Excellent English communication is a requirement, not a preference.

Candidates must be comfortable participating in professional video meetings with U.S.-based employees.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

We value independence, accountability, honesty, technical excellence, and measurable results.



You should be capable of:

1. Understanding business problems without constant supervision.

2. Identifying and recommending appropriate technical solutions.

3. Developing clear implementation plans.

4. Establishing realistic project milestones.

5. Building and testing applications.

6. Communicating progress and identifying obstacles.

7. Delivering reliable, functional software.

8. Documenting completed systems.

9. Training employees when necessary.

10. Maintaining and improving deployed applications.



All developed systems must follow company security requirements, use company-controlled repositories and approved infrastructure, and be properly documented.



We expect transparent communication regarding technical limitations, integration restrictions, and project risks.



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



DAYS 1–30: UNDERSTAND, EVALUATE, AND PLAN

Learn Keyprime’s existing software environment.

Meet with department leaders to understand operational workflows.

Review current automation tools and identify opportunities for improvement. 

Present a prioritized development roadmap.



DAYS 31–60: DEVELOP AND DELIVER

Implement an approved improvement to the production reporting system.

Begin developing the foundation for automated estimating and pricing integration.

Demonstrate working functionality and measurable operational improvements.



DAYS 61–90: EXPAND AND DEMONSTRATE LEADERSHIP

Complete another approved automation milestone.

Demonstrate reliable, documented, and maintainable software solutions.

Present a proposed six-month development roadmap.

Identify future engineering resources that may be required to expand development capacity.



Following the 90-day evaluation, company leadership will assess opportunities for compensation growth, expanded responsibilities, and potential engineering team development.



Final project milestones will be established after reviewing our existing systems and technical requirements.



HOW TO APPLY



We are interested in understanding who you are, what you have accomplished, and why you believe you are the right person to help build Keyprime’s technology infrastructure.



Please submit the following:



1. PROFESSIONAL RÉSUMÉ

Provide your professional experience, technical qualifications, and relevant employment history.



2. PORTFOLIO AND PREVIOUS PROJECTS

Provide two or three examples of applications you have personally developed.

Include examples of API integrations, AI-powered applications, or business automation systems.

Explain your specific responsibilities and the results achieved.



3. PROFESSIONAL REFERENCES AND RECOMMENDATIONS

Provide professional recommendations, testimonials, or references from previous employers, clients, supervisors, or business partners who can speak to your technical abilities, reliability, and professional performance.



4. COMPENSATION EXPECTATIONS

Provide your expected monthly salary in USD.



5. AVAILABILITY

Confirm your ability to work full-time and participate in scheduled meetings during U.S. Central Time.



6. MANDATORY VIDEO INTRODUCTION — MOST IMPORTANT

We want to hear directly from you.

Please record a professional 3–5 minute video introduction using Loom, Google Drive, or another video recording platform.

Your video should answer the following questions:



A. WHO ARE YOU?

Briefly introduce yourself, your professional background, and your current area of expertise.



B. WHAT HAVE YOU BUILT?

Tell us about the applications, AI systems, automation tools, and integrations you have personally developed.

Explain your technical strengths and the types of problems you are most qualified to solve.



C. WHAT MAKES YOU DIFFERENT?

What technical capabilities, professional experiences, or leadership qualities distinguish you from other senior developers?



D. WHY DOES THIS OPPORTUNITY INTEREST YOU?

Explain what attracts you to this position, including the opportunity to develop business automation systems and potentially build and lead an engineering team.



E. MOST IMPORTANTLY — WHY SHOULD KEYPRIME HIRE YOU?

This is the most important part of your introduction.

Tell us why you believe you are the right person for this position.

What makes you confident you can successfully develop our AI and automation infrastructure?

What value will you bring to our company?

Why should we choose you over other qualified candidates?

We want to hear your reasoning, understand your professional ambitions, and see how you communicate.

You do not need professional video equipment or editing.

A simple, clear recording is sufficient.

We care about your knowledge, communication, experience, confidence, and ability to explain why you are the right candidate.



IMPORTANT — VIDEO SUBMISSION IS REQUIRED



APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED WITHOUT A VIDEO INTRODUCTION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



YOUR RÉSUMÉ ALONE IS NOT SUFFICIENT.



YOU MUST INCLUDE A WORKING, ACCESSIBLE VIDEO LINK RECORDED THROUGH LOOM, GOOGLE DRIVE, OR ANOTHER VIDEO PLATFORM.



YOUR VIDEO MUST CLEARLY EXPLAIN WHO YOU ARE, YOUR TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE, WHAT YOU HAVE BUILT, AND MOST IMPORTANTLY, WHY YOU BELIEVE KEYPRIME SHOULD HIRE YOU.



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE REQUIRED VIDEO OR WITH INACCESSIBLE VIDEO LINKS WILL NOT ADVANCE TO THE INTERVIEW PROCESS.



WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU DIRECTLY — NOT SIMPLY READ ABOUT YOU.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a technical interview and paid practical development assessment.



BUILD SOMETHING MEANINGFUL. GROW INTO LEADERSHIP.

This is more than an opportunity to write code.

It is an opportunity to help establish the technological foundation of a growing American company.

You will have the freedom to innovate, the responsibility to deliver meaningful solutions, and the potential to develop into a senior engineering leadership position.

If you are an experienced engineer who values professional independence, challenging projects, clear communication, long-term growth, and recognition for exceptional results, we encourage you to apply.



Keyprime Inc.

Minnesota, United States

title: Virtual Assistant — Founder Support, Ops & Content
description:
WHO WE ARE



Citibin designs and manufactures architectural trash and recycling enclosures — the kind you see outside apartment buildings, business districts, parks, and resort properties, replacing the exposed bins nobody wants sitting out front. We're a Brooklyn-based, 100% woman-owned company founded in 2012. Property managers, developers, HOAs, municipalities, and business improvement districts across the country install our enclosures — along with our public litter baskets, bear-resistant enclosures, and package lockers. We're a small team that moves fast, and we need someone who can keep up with us and make us better.



THE ROLE



You'll own four things for us.



First, and most important: helping our founder stay focused. She's running a fast-moving company with a lot of moving pieces, and she needs someone tracking her active projects, surfacing what actually needs her attention now versus later, and flagging when something is falling behind. This isn't a passive task-list role — you need to develop real judgment about what matters most.



Second is the post-installation
 sequence — the series of
s we send clients after their CITIBIN enclosure is installed. You'll manage and reply to these so every client gets a real, timely response, not a missed follow-up. You'll also collect installation photos from our assembly technicians, plot each location on our map, and log every completed install into Airtable.



Third is government RFP monitoring. Cities, municipalities, parks departments, sanitation departments, universities, and other public agencies regularly put out RFPs for exactly what we sell, and we need someone who can set up a system to catch those the moment they open — without us paying for a stack of expensive procurement-monitoring subscriptions. You'll need to know where this information actually lives (agency websites, state and local procurement portals, and other public sources) and how to track it efficiently on your own.



Fourth is managing our outside writers, content creators, and graphic designer. We want content that doesn't read like AI slop — writers who can take one strong piece of content (say, a blog post) and repurpose it well across
 newsletters, social media, and web copy. You'll quality-control what they produce before it's handed off to our external media agency, who schedules and publishes it. You'll also help keep our graphic designer — very creative, but not always great at following priorities — focused on what actually needs to get done.



Beyond these four responsibilities, we want someone who is AI-savvy, not just AI-proficient — someone who already uses AI tools to work faster and more accurately, and picks up new ones quickly.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Executive Prioritization & Project Tracking



Keep track of the founder's active projects across the business and help surface what actually needs her attention now versus later

Proactively flag when priorities are shifting, deadlines are at risk, or something is falling behind

Act as a second set of eyes on where her time is going, so she's spending it on the highest-leverage things



Post-Installation
 Sequence



Manage and reply to the post-installation
 sequence sent to clients after every completed install

Collect installation photos from our assembly technicians and upload them into Airtable

Plot each new installation location on our map

Log every completed installation into Airtable, accurately and the same day



Government RFP Monitoring



Build and maintain a monitoring system to catch open and upcoming RFPs relevant to Citibin — parks departments, cities, municipalities, sanitation departments, universities, and other public buyers

Know how to find this information yourself — agency websites, state/local procurement portals, and other public sources — without relying on a pile of paid subscription services

Flag relevant opportunities early enough for us to actually respond



Content & Creative Management



Identify and manage outside writers and content services who produce genuinely original work — not AI slop

Make sure writers can take one piece of content (a blog post, for example) and repurpose it well across
 newsletters, social media, and web copy

Quality-control content before handing it off to our external media agency, who handles scheduling and publishing

Manage our graphic designer — creative, but needs help staying on the priorities that matter most

WHAT YOU BRING

Strong judgment on prioritization — able to track multiple projects at once and proactively flag what's actually urgent

Excellent written English and a genuinely responsive, professional tone for client-facing
s

An eye for content quality — can tell the difference between generic AI-generated writing and something that actually sounds like a real brand, and can screen writers and content services accordingly

Comfortable managing outside vendors and freelancers (writers, designers) and keeping them accountable to deadlines and priorities

Genuine AI fluency — AI-savvy, not just AI-proficient. You use AI tools daily to work faster and more accurately, and you can pick up new tools quickly when a task calls for it

A resourceful researcher — comfortable digging into government and public-sector websites to find procurement information yourself, not just searching one database and stopping

Comfortable with Airtable, or able to learn it quickly

Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently on a recurring schedule

NICE TO HAVE

Experience managing freelance writers, content creators, or a small creative team

Experience with Apollo, Clay, Instantly, or similar AI-assisted sales/outreach tools

Experience with a media/digital asset management system — organizing photos and videos so they're easily searchable and reusable later

HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with TRASH and tell us: (1) how you've helped a busy founder or executive prioritize and stay on top of multiple projects, and (2) your experience replying to customer
s and/or managing outside writers or freelancers.

Fully Remote — Philippines-based



--------------------

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

We are NOT looking for someone to train from scratch. We need a proven closer who can pick up a phone, talk to warm leads, handle objections, and enroll clients on day 1.



If you have never worked in outbound sales before, please do not apply. If you quit your last job within 2 weeks, please do not apply. If your internet is slow or your computer is old, please do not apply.



If you are a confident, experienced closer who wants to earn serious money working from home — keep reading.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

--------------------

- Call warm leads daily — people who already filled out a form asking about credit repair

- NO cold calling. Every lead is inbound and pre-qualified

- Explain our packages, handle objections, and close enrollments

- Minimum 100 dials per day

- Log all outcomes in our CRM portal after every call

- Attend 9AM EST team meeting Monday through Friday

REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE

--------------------

- Minimum 2 years outbound sales experience (BPO, insurance, real estate, credit, or any direct sales)

- Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and persuasive on the phone

- Stable internet: minimum 10 Mbps download (you will be tested)

- Reliable computer with working headset

- Available Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST (10:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine Time)

--------------------

COMPENSATION — THIS IS NOT $100/WEEK

--------------------

Commission (per enrollment closed):

- Express Package ($3,999): $250 commission

title: Real Estate Personal Assistant / Operations Analyst
description:
Personal Assistant / Operations Analyst



Role summary

The Personal Assistant / Operations Analyst runs the operating rhythm of a NYC-based multifamily investment fund and keeps the principal's deal pipeline, relationships and projects moving every day.



This is a full-time independent contractor engagement with a NYC-based multifamily investment fund, reporting directly to the principal. The role is remote, 40 hours per week, 9am to 6pm US Eastern time, with a daily touch base at 5:30pm ET. Compensation is a fixed salary paid weekly.



The role is half analyst, half assistant. The analyst half owns the acquisition pipeline: brokers, deals, the weekly underwriting pick and the content that comes out of it. The assistant half owns the principal's calendar, personal contacts and the projects that keep the business running.



What the role is for

The job exists so that three things are true every week: brokers keep sending deals, one deal goes to the underwriter, and nothing waiting on the principal waits more than a day.



The work falls into three verticals, in priority order:

1. Deal pipeline. Keep broker relationships live, screen every deal that comes in, prepare the weekly underwriting pick, track the model with the underwriter, and turn finished models into content shared back with contacts. This is a distinct vertical and the core of the role.

2. Personal relationships. Manage the principal's personal contacts, LinkedIn and a short list of specific relationships. This list stays short and under close oversight even as the business scales. Nothing goes out to a personal contact without the principal's context on that person.

3. Projects and SOPs. Track operations projects, write and maintain SOPs, and flag what is blocked or needs a priority call.

The daily touch base is the control point for all three. The analyst runs it, the principal d
. The principal is often away from a screen, so the role has to work by voice and by short written messages, not by screen share.



Responsibilities

Deal pipeline

• Run broker outreach and keep every live broker in regular contact, with each
, call and reply logged in the CRM the same day.

• Screen every incoming deal against the buy box (unit count, vintage, market, business plan, renovation budget) and log it on the deal desk with broker, market, units, price, deadline and fit.

• Chase deal files: confidentiality agreements, offering memos, rent rolls and T12s. Note what is in hand and what is still owed.

• Track offer dates and calls for offers in the next seven days and raise them before they slip.

• Reply to every broker on every deal, including a courteous pass, so brokers see the fund as active.

• Prepare candidate deals each Monday with a recommendation so the principal can pick the week's underwriting deal, then send the brief to the underwriter.

• Track the underwriter's model to completion each week and report status.

• Turn finished models into content and share it with the relevant contacts.

• Book broker calls into the principal's open calendar slots without needing to ask.

Personal relationships

• Manage Wesley's personal contact list, LinkedIn activity and a short list of specific relationships.

• Bring each contact up one at a time with a proposed next touch. Send nothing to a personal contact without Wesley's context on that person.

• Keep the contact records, statuses and next-action dates current.

Projects and SOPs

• Keep the operations tracker current: every project touched gets a status note, a stage and a blocked flag with the reason where it applies.

• Carry one SOP at a time from draft through review to live, and keep a current list of every SOP by stage.

• Flag anything blocked, stale or needing a priority call, and propose the call.

• Run ad hoc projects such as contact consolidation, LinkedIn exports and tool setup.

Assistant duties

• Keep the principal's calendar current and schedule meetings into his standing morning and evening slots.

• Draft messages and follow-ups for the principal's review.

• Handle the administrative tasks that come up in a small, fast-moving business.



How the week runs

The role has a fixed rhythm. You run it; the principal shows up to it.

Daily. Update the tracker and CRM before 5pm ET, then send a short pre-read by WhatsApp: decisions needed first, then the day's numbers. At 5:30pm ET run a touch base of up to 30 minutes in a fixed order: decisions waiting on the principal, deal pipeline, personal relationships, projects and SOPs, then a wrap-up of what was d
, what the principal owes, what was parked and the top priority before the next call. Within 30 minutes of the call, log every outcome where it belongs and send a recap of under 60 words. If the call is skipped, send the agenda as a message and the principal answers it from his commute, so a skipped call never means a skipped day.

Monday. Present candidate deals with a recommendation. The principal picks the week's underwriting deal and the brief goes to the underwriter.

Friday. Report deals received this week, model status, content shared, every SOP by stage, and whether broker outreach should expand or hold.

Quarterly. Report how many live brokers sent at least one deal this quarter, list the quiet ones, and recommend re-engage or retire for each.



Tools you will work in

The fund's own operations site is the source of truth: an operations tracker for projects and SOPs, and a CRM with contacts, outreach and a deal desk for opportunities. If it is not in the tracker or the CRM, it did not happen. You update before the call, not after.



Around that you will use WhatsApp for pre-reads and recaps, Google Calendar for scheduling, LinkedIn for outreach and contact management, Gmail, and spreadsheets for deal screening. AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT are part of the daily workflow for drafting, summarizing and research. You should be comfortable using them as a tool, not as a replacement for your own judgment.



Who we are looking for

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will speak with US commercial real estate brokers and write on the principal's behalf.

• Strong analytical and reasoning skills. You can read an offering memo, pull out units, price per door, vintage and deadline, and say whether the deal fits and why.

• Organized to the point of discipline. You keep trackers current without being asked and never let an open question sit more than a day.

• Able to run a meeting with an owner. You lead the agenda, state each item in three sentences or fewer, ask one question at a time and move on when you get the answer.

• Comfortable working by voice and short messages. Your manager is often on the move, so you have to be clear by ear, not by screen.

• Experienced with CRMs and project trackers. Real estate, finance or investment experience is a plus but not required.

• Fluent with AI tools and able to tell when their output is wrong.

• Discreet. You will handle the principal's personal contacts and private business information.

• Available 9am to 6pm US Eastern time with a reliable connection and a quiet place to take calls.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

• The daily touch base runs on time, in order, in under 30 minutes, with the pre-read sent by 5pm ET every working day.

• New deals arrive every week and every one is screened, logged and answered.

• One deal goes to the underwriter every Monday and its model is tracked to completion.

• Finished models are turned into content and shared with contacts.

• The operations tracker and CRM are never stale: no project untouched for seven days without a note.

• At least one SOP has gone from draft to live.

• The principal knows at any time how many brokers are live and which ones have gone quiet.



How to apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, your resume. We will reply within one week to candidates we want to speak with.

- You’re resourceful. You figure things out without step-by-step instructions.

- You’re honest, especially when something goes wrong. You tell us early, and you keep pay and personal information private.

- You stay calm when five things break at once, and you’re firm but fair with people.

- You take feedback well and improve fast.



WHAT YOU’RE GREAT AT

- Hiring: you know where to find good people, how to judge their work and how to spot red flags.

- Managing a remote team: you follow up and keep people on track.

- AI: you use tools like ChatGPT or Claude every day to work faster, and you check what they give you.

- Organizing: you write things down and build simple checklists and trackers, so nothing falls through the cracks.

- Clear, simple written English, and tools like ClickUp, Google Drive, 
 and Loom.







NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working with video editors or another creative team.

- Experience in e-commerce.



THIS ISN’T FOR YOU IF

- You work slowly, or you need someone to tell you how to solve every problem.

- You want a strict 9-to-5. This is a full-time role, and some days run longer than 8 hours.



WHAT YOU GET

- $2,000–$3,000 per month, depending on experience.

- Raises as you grow with us, and a path to Head of Operations.

- Real ownership. You’ll run the people side of a fast-growing brand.





HOW TO APPLY

This role is about solving problems fast, so your application is a test.



Record one video (Loom or any screen recorder) with your screen AND camera on, in one take, with no pausing or editing. Think out loud the whole time: we care more about how you think than about being perfect. It takes about 10–12 minutes.



1. INTRODUCE YOURSELF (1–2 minutes)

Who you are, and the people or teams you’ve hired and managed before.



2. THREE QUICK TESTS (up to 5 minutes)

Do all three live on screen, once each:

- Sequence Memory: 

  Remember the order the blocks light up. Keep going until you miss, then show us your level.

- Reaction Time: 

  Click as soon as the screen turns green. Do all 5 tries and show us your average.

- Typing: 

  Type the text as fast and accurately as you can, then show us your score.



3. ANSWER TWO QUESTIONS (up to 4 minutes)

a) It’s Monday morning. Two editors missed their deadlines last week, one hasn’t replied in two days, pay is due today, and we need a new editor by Friday. What do you do first, second and third, and why?

b) Roughly how many hours would it take you to hire 10 new video editors, from writing the job post to their first day? Walk us through your numbers.



Don’t use ChatGPT or any other AI for this video.



If your Loom stops recording at 5 minutes, use another screen recorder or send two links.



Start your application with the word RIGHTHAND, then paste your video link. Applications without a video won’t be reviewed.



What happens next: if your video stands out, we’ll invite you to a call. After the call, the best candidates do a paid trial.



Every video is carefully reviewed, and we only invite people to the next step when we genuinely think they’re a great fit.

title: Wholesale Real Estate VA - Seller Communications and Lead Management
description:
About us

Lineflow is a real estate investment operation based in Houston, Texas. We buy single family homes directly from sellers (wholesaling) and we are building our acquisitions system now. You will be the person who keeps seller conversations moving every day. This is a long term role with a growing company, not a one off gig.



Pay is $600-$800 USD per month to start, plus a bonus for every deal we close from leads you work. You must be available during US Central Time business hours.



What you will do

- Handle seller communications across SMS,
, and phone follow up. Fast, friendly, professional replies.

- Work new seller leads the same day they come in. No lead sits untouched.

- Follow up with older leads on a set schedule until they sell, list with an agent, or tell us no.

- Keep the CRM clean and current: every conversation logged, every lead in the right stage, follow up tasks never overdue.

- Book motivated sellers onto calls with the owner and send reminders so they show up.

- Send new deals out to our cash buyer list and track buyer replies.

- Daily end of day report: leads touched, conversations started, appointments set, anything stuck.



What you must have

- Real experience working for a US real estate wholesaler or investor. This is required. Tell us exactly who you worked for and what you handled.

- Strong written and spoken English. Sellers must feel they are talking to a professional local team.

- Experience with at least one real estate CRM or lead system (for example Podio, GoHighLevel, REsimpli, InvestorFuse, Follow Up Boss, or similar) and with SMS or dialer tools.

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to work, and a headset.

- You are organized and you follow up without being reminded. Most deals come from follow up, not first contact.



Nice to have

- Dispositions experience: talking to cash buyers, sending deal packets, tracking offers.

- Skip tracing or list management experience.

- Experience writing seller follow up sequences.



How to apply

Start your application message with the word PIPELINE so we know you read the whole post. Applications without it will not be read.



Then answer these questions:

1. Which US wholesalers or investors have you worked for, for how long, and what exactly did you handle day to day?

2. Which CRMs, SMS tools, and dialers have you used?

3. A seller replied last week: "Not interested, stop texting me." Today the same seller texts: "Actually, what would you pay for it?" Write exactly what you would do and say next.

4. How many hours per week are you available, what hours in US Central Time, and do you currently work for other real estate clients?

5. Record a short voice introduction (1 minute or less) telling us about your wholesaling experience, and include the link.



We reply to strong applications within a few days with a short paid test task before any offer.

title: Senior Magento 2 Developer — Ongoing Part-Time Contract
description:
Remote | Initially 15–20 hours per week | Rate negotiable based on demonstrated Magento expertise



We are an established UK ecommerce business seeking an experienced Magento 2 developer for a long-term working relationship. You will work directly with the business owner to maintain and improve an existing store, resolve technical problems and deliver carefully scoped projects.



We want a hands-on senior developer who can investigate issues independently, explain options clearly and take responsibility for reliable releases. The role starts part-time, with potential to grow towards full-time as the workload and working relationship develop. Increased hours are not guaranteed.



THE WORK



- Assess, install and update third-party extensions, resolve compatibility issues and test their effect on existing functionality.

- Investigate checkout, payment, shipping and tax issues.

- Improve performance, including database queries, caching and frontend behaviour.

- Develop and maintain custom modules, inventory workflows, imports and API integrations.

- Make practical frontend improvements within an existing theme.

- Maintain clear estimates, source control, release notes, test evidence and rollback procedures.



TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE



Our platform is Magento Open Source 2.4.x with approximately 25,000 SKUs, an established Luma/Porto-based frontend and multiple third-party extensions. Experience maintaining a catalogue of this scale is important.



You should have:

- Substantial hands-on Magento 2 experience, ideally five or more years, including ongoing ownership of live stores.

- Strong PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Knockout.js, RequireJS, HTML and CSS skills.

- Practical understanding of Magento MSI, reservations, salable quantity, indexing, cron and queues.

- Experience diagnosing Redis/Varnish caching and performance issues.

- Confidence with Composer, Git, Linux, staging environments and controlled deployments.

- Experience creating maintainable Magento modules and working with REST APIs and data imports.

- Clear written and spoken English and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to a business owner.



Adobe/Magento certification is welcome, but demonstrated delivery and sound judgement matter most.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



We expect to begin with a small paid technical trial on staging, with scope and an hours cap agreed in advance. A successful trial would lead to an initial 6–8-week part-time engagement, reviewed together before extending.



Please propose regular availability and at least two hours of overlap with UK business hours on agreed working days. Release support and any out-of-hours work will be agreed separately; this is not a 24/7 on-call role.



Work will follow a prioritised backlog. Estimates and additional scope must be agreed before work starts. Production changes require approval, appropriate testing and a rollback plan. Code and technical documentation must be maintained in the client's repository.



We prefer to work directly with the developer doing the work. Please disclose any agency arrangement or proposed subcontracting in your application.



TO APPLY



Please include concise answers to the following:



1. Describe two Magento 2 stores or projects you have personally maintained. Explain your responsibilities and one difficult problem you solved. Anonymised examples are welcome where client confidentiality applies.

2. Describe an extension conflict, checkout fault or caching issue you diagnosed. How did you find the cause and verify the fix?

3. How would you test shared inventory across different product SKUs, including simultaneous orders, cancellations and refunds? A short explanation is sufficient; no unpaid implementation is requested.

4. Explain your normal staging, source-control, testing, deployment and rollback workflow.

5. State your best hourly rate and your proposed monthly price for a regular 20-hour working week. Specify included monthly hours, any minimum commitment and the rate for additional agreed hours. Give your weekly availability, UK working-hour overlap and earliest start date. Include any relevant certification and a code sample you have permission to share, if available.



Company details will be shared privately with shortlisted candidates. Please apply through the recruitment platform.

Start your application with “LCMS Proposal Support” and include:

title: YouTube Uploader / Channel Manager - (Multiple Uploads a Day)
description:
We run several long-form YouTube channels. Every video is already finished and packaged: video file, title, description, tags, pinned comment and an approved thumbnail. Your job is to upload it to the RIGHT channel, fill in EVERY field correctly, and publish at the time we give you. You will upload multiple videos a day across our channels.



This is a careful, follow-the-checklist job, not a creative one. One wrong channel or one missed field costs us real money, so we hire for accuracy and honesty, not speed.



WHAT YOU DO

- Open our work board and pick the video marked ready.

- Open the correct channel's assigned browser profile (we give you access; every channel has its own profile - you never sign in anywhere else).

- Upload the video in YouTube Studio and fill in: title, description, tags, thumbnail, pinned comment, the AI-content disclosure tick, and collaborator tags when the board says so.

- Schedule or publish at the time given.

- Mark the video as done on the board and in its Google Drive folder.

- Report any problem straight away instead of guessing.



WHAT YOU NEVER DO (strict)

title: Accountant | 6-Month Contract
description:
About Us



Mad Mex is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



We’re looking for an Accountant to join us on a 6-month contract, with the potential to become permanent for the right person. You’ll own our Payroll and Bank Reconciliation processes and keep the numbers behind every restaurant accurate and on time. You’ll also back up the wider Finance team and help shape how we use AI and automation to work smarter.





What You’ll Be Doing



Payroll



- Own the end-to-end payroll process, from timesheet validation and pay runs through to releasing pay and lodging STP.

- Pay super and PAYG, and prepare, lodge and pay payroll tax in line with statutory and company deadlines.

- Deliver the weekly labour report on time and reconcile payroll balance sheet accounts.

- Manage the payroll inbox and respond to internal and ad hoc payroll queries.

- Liaise with our Workers Compensation insurer on annual lodgements and declarations across states and entities.

- Drive continuous improvement in payroll processes.



Bank & Revenue Reconciliations



- Complete daily bank reconciliations, investigating unmatched deposits and missing bankings with Business Managers.

- Reconcile petty cash weekly, confirm till floats by store monthly, and reconcile credit cards monthly back to the GL.

- Reconcile cash receipts, EFTPOS and Windcave online order receipts, and assist with delivery reconciliations when required.



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Reporting



- Support AP, including booking invoices in NetSuite, validating the weekly AP export from TASK, reconciling supplier statements, and processing AP and rent payments.

- Support AR, including raising royalty, marketing fee and ad hoc invoices, processing direct debits and following up the AR ageing.

- Manage the shared Accounts inbox daily and support cash flow reporting.

- Own assigned period end tasks and monthly balance sheet reconciliations, and support audits with accurate, timely reports.

- Deliver ad hoc projects and special reports that give the business sharper insights.



AI, Automation & System Transformation



- Support our Finance AI automation project by documenting current processes and identifying manual pain points and automation opportunities.

- Act as a finance subject matter expert, translating accounting and compliance requirements into clear business rules for the project team and technology partners.

- Assist with solution design, UAT, data validation and parallel runs to make sure automated outputs are accurate and compliant.

- Help maintain controls, approvals, audit trails and exception handling in automated workflows.

- Support data quality and master data clean-up across NetSuite, payroll and related systems.

- Update procedures, prepare training materials and help the Finance team adopt new tools and processes.





What You Bring



- 3+ years’ accounting experience, including end-to-end payroll and bank reconciliations (hospitality preferred).

- Qualifications in accounting, business or commerce.

- Sound knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including STP, superannuation, PAYG, payroll tax and workers compensation.

- Experience with ERP and payroll systems; Oracle NetSuite, Tanda and KeyPay preferred.

-Broad exposure across AP, AR, bank and revenue reconciliations, period end and balance sheet reconciliations.

-A strong interest in AI and automation within finance, with the ability to document processes and support testing and adoption of new tools. System transformation experience is preferred.

- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (macros, XLOOKUPs); Power Query preferred.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure and work independently or in a team.

- A stable internet connection for remote work.

- Most importantly, you’re curious, adaptable and ready to Own It.



Why Mad Mex?



You’ll join a fast-growing Familia where Finance directly supports our restaurants, our people and our franchise partners.



There’s plenty of opportunity to learn, innovate, improve and grow into new areas of the department.



Bring your numbers game. Bring your curiosity for automation. Bring the Por El Sabor.





Please include a link to your CV and your monthly salary expectations with your application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We can’t wait to see the spice you’ll bring to the table!

title: Growth Marketing Manager – Australian Hospitality Brand
description:
About Us



ALL DAY is an independent café based in Brisbane, Australia. We serve breakfast, brunch and specialty coffee, with a strong focus on quality food, customer experience and building a loyal local community.



We're an established business with an existing customer base, active digital channels and plenty of opportunities for growth.



We're looking for an experienced, commercially minded marketing professional to take ownership of our marketing strategy and execution.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant, content creator or social media scheduling role.



We need someone who can identify opportunities, develop ideas and independently turn them into results.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Marketing Strategy & Growth

Develop and execute marketing campaigns focused on increasing weekday trade, repeat visits and revenue.

Identify new opportunities to attract customers and grow the business.

Build and manage a marketing calendar with clear objectives and measurable outcomes.

Evaluate campaign performance and continuously improve our marketing approach.

Partnerships & Local Marketing

Identify and approach local businesses, community groups, fitness clubs and organisations for potential collaborations.

Manage influencer partnerships, from initial outreach through to campaign execution and follow-up.

Develop strategies to grow catering enquiries, group bookings and private events.

Proactively identify relevant local events and promotional opportunities.



Local Marketing & Community Engagement

Develop and execute local marketing initiatives that increase awareness, attract new customers and drive repeat visits to ALL DAY. We're looking for someone who can proactively identify opportunities within our local community and turn them into measurable business results.



Local Business Partnerships: Identify and build relationships with nearby businesses, offices, residential buildings, hotels, gyms and other organisations to generate customer visits, catering enquiries and group bookings.

Community Engagement: Develop relationships with local community groups, fitness clubs, social groups and event organisers to create opportunities for collaborations and events.

Grassroots Marketing: Plan and coordinate letterbox drops, flyers, posters, local promotions, sampling activities and other offline marketing initiatives.

Local Events & Activations: Identify opportunities to participate in local events, markets and community activities, as well as develop events and promotions hosted at the café.

Resident & Neighbourhood MarketingDevelop targeted campaigns for nearby apartment residents, local workers and surrounding neighbourhoods to increase customer frequency.

Corporate Outreach: Proactively approach local offices and businesses to promote catering, workplace breakfasts, meetings and group bookings.

Local PR & Media: Build relationships with Brisbane food publications, community media, local influencers and relevant event platforms to generate publicity.

Campaign Measurement: Track the outcomes of local marketing initiatives, including enquiries, redemptions, bookings, customer visits and attributable revenue.



The expectation is to actively develop and execute local marketing opportunities, not simply suggest ideas. You'll be responsible for identifying potential partners, making contact, coordinating activities and following through to measurable outcomes.



Digital Marketing & Content

Take ownership of our Instagram and
 marketing.

Develop original, engaging content ideas that reflect our brand and actual customer experience.

Coordinate photography, video content and creative assets.

Plan and execute
 marketing campaigns that encourage repeat visits and customer engagement.

Maintain and optimise our website, Google Business Profile and relevant online platforms.



Campaign Execution & Reporting

Independently coordinate and execute campaigns from concept to completion.

Manage external suppliers, photographers, content creators and other partners.

Track campaign results, including customer enquiries, bookings, engagement and revenue where measurable.

Provide clear reporting on what has worked, what hasn't and what should happen next.



Operations & Executive Support

Alongside marketing responsibilities, you'll provide practical administrative and operational support to the business owner. We're looking for someone versatile, organised and comfortable handling a variety of tasks as needed.

POS & Online Ordering Management: Maintain and update our point-of-sale, online ordering and delivery platforms, including menu changes, pricing, promotions, product availability and system configuration.

Executive Assistance: Assist with ad hoc business and personal administration, including travel research and bookings, scheduling, reservations and general coordination.

Recruitment Support: Manage job advertisements, screen applications, shortlist candidates, coordinate interviews and assist with onboarding.

Research & Special Projects: Undertake research, investigate solutions and manage occasional projects or tasks assigned by the business owner.

This component of the role will vary from week to week. Marketing remains the primary focus, but flexibility, initiative and a willingness to support the broader business are essential.



Who We're Looking For

Ideally, you have experience as a Marketing Manager, Growth Marketing Specialist or Account Manager within a digital or creative marketing agency.



Essential requirements:



Minimum 3 years of relevant marketing experience.

Demonstrated experience independently developing and executing marketing campaigns.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage projects, priorities and deadlines without constant supervision.

Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how marketing contributes to revenue.

Confidence making recommendations, challenging ideas constructively and taking ownership of outcomes.

A proactive, resourceful approach to identifying and solving problems.



Highly regarded:

Marketing experience with cafés, restaurants, hospitality, retail or other consumer-facing businesses.

Influencer marketing, partnerships and community engagement experience.

 marketing and customer retention campaigns.

Experience with Canva, Meta Business Suite, Squarespace, Google Analytics and
 marketing platforms.

Familiarity with the Australian consumer market.



How We Work

You'll work directly with the owner of ALL DAY and have the autonomy to develop ideas, make recommendations and manage marketing execution.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative rather than waits for instructions.

We value original thinking, creativity, accuracy and attention to detail over high volumes of generic content.

You'll be responsible for planning your work, meeting agreed deadlines and communicating progress proactively.

We don't believe in unnecessary meetings or micromanagement, but we do expect accountability and consistent delivery.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Tell us about a marketing campaign you personally initiated and managed. What was the objective, what did you do, and what were the measurable results?



Imagine you're responsible for marketing a busy Australian café that wants to increase weekday customer visits. What are the first three opportunities you would investigate, and why?



What experience do you have marketing hospitality, retail or other consumer-facing businesses?



Have you worked at a marketing agency or managed marketing independently for clients? Please describe your responsibilities.



What is your expected monthly salary for 25 hours per week?



Please don't send a generic cover letter.



We're interested in your actual experience, your thinking and your ability to independently deliver results. Specific examples of campaigns you've managed are much more valuable than a polished CV.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and may be asked to complete a paid practical marketing assessment.



We look forward to hearing from you.



ALL DAY

Brisbane, Australia

title: Property Manager/Vendor Coordination
description:
Location: Remote 

Core Availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Eastern Time (USA) 

Compensation: up to $2,000 per month 



SteelSafe Self Storage operates storage properties across the United States. Customers rent individual storage units and shipping containers from us to store their belongings, business inventory, equipment, and other items. 



Our properties are managed remotely. When a customer moves out, we need to quickly inspect, clean, repair, and prepare that storage unit so the next customer can rent it. 



We’re hiring a Vendor Coordination/Property Manager to own that process remotely. Your main goal is simple: keep our properties Rent-Ready and get units back on the market fast. 



What you get: 

A clear scoreboard and a role that matters. 

Direct access to leadership and fast decisions. 

A system-driven operation (we run on Asana). 

Performance bonus opportunity tied to ops execution. 

High trust and real autonomy. 

Real authority. You are not here to pass problems to someone else. You have the authority to solve them and improve the systems behind them. 

Freedom earned through results. We care about outcomes, not looking busy. Own the result, get the job done, then build systems so the job demands less of you tomorrow. 



What you’ll do: 

Manage the entire unit turnover process: after a customer moves out, make sure the unit is inspected, cleaned, repaired if needed, and ready for the next customer to rent. 

Manage local Boots-On-The-Ground (BOTG) contractors who physically inspect, clean, repair, and maintain our properties. 

Assign maintenance and repair jobs, follow up until they are completed, and verify the finished work using photos or videos.

Asana as the operating system (tasks, checklists, proof).

Take initiative. Act fast. Identify problems, make sound decisions, and act within your authority without waiting for instructions. Clear your blockers fast. Move with relentless urgency.
