title: Operations Execution
description:
Operations Execution Lead

Compensation: $2,400/month



Mission

Turn priorities into finished results.



SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems.



Your job is to own that execution.



Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors.



Either way, you own the result.



When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.





Operating Rules

Own the result. Do not pass problems.

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.

No proof = not done.

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.



What You Own



1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution



Drive property work from problem to verified completion.



Examples:

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.

Coordinate cleanouts.

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.



The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close



Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline.



Do not report that a unit is stuck.



Get it unstuck.



2. BOTG & Vendor Management



Own the people who execute work locally.

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.

Give clear scopes and deadlines.

Get quotes.

Follow up.

Verify work.

Correct poor work.

Replace underperformers.

Maintain backup options.



“I asked them” is not a result.



The work being completed correctly is the result.



3. Projects & Procurement

Own independent projects from idea to completion.



Examples include:

Source and purchase supplies or equipment.

Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials.

Research and negotiate vendors or services.

Sell unused assets.

Coordinate property improvement projects.

Build new operational processes.

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.



You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction.



4. Operational Problem Resolution

When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.

Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.

Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.

Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.

Work gets completed on time.

Projects do not stall.

Take ownership without reminders.

Finish what you start.

Can manage a small team and still execute personally.

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.

Follow up relentlessly.

Make good decisions independently.

Keep many moving pieces organized.

Communicate problems early.

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.

Care about details and proof.

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.

title: Senior Media Buyer – Meta & Google Ads (Healthcare) — Part-Time, Remote (Philippines)
description:
CANAM Sports Medicine · Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, USA · Remote contractor · ~20 hours/week · 1,000–1,700/month (USD)



About CANAM



CANAM Sports Medicine is a cash-pay sports chiropractic and performance rehabilitation clinic in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona. We help active adults, most of them 48–62, get out of pain so they can keep golfing, hiking and keeping up with their grandkids. We grow through paid ads, lead magnets, free workshops and gym partnerships, and every lead is worked by our patient success team.



The Role

We're looking for an experienced media buyer to own our paid acquisition on Meta and Google. We want a strategist, not just someone who executes instructions. We expect you to tell us when you think we're wrong. Every week you'll walk the CEO through results and new ideas. You'll work with our in-house video editor: you write the creative briefs, they produce the ads. You report directly to the CEO, and the number that matters most is cost per new patient plan of care, not clicks or cheap leads.



This is a part-time role, about 20 hours per week, with room to grow to full-time as our ad spend scales. No night shift required.



What You'll Own



Meta Ads 
/Instagram): campaign strategy, builds, creative testing, audiences, budget pacing and retargeting for our lead magnet funnels (knee, low back and shoulder pain guides).



Google Ads: Search and Local Services Ads, including keyword strategy, negative keywords, bidding and landing page alignment.

Weekly strategy and ideas: a 30-minute strategy call with the CEO every week covering last week's results, what to keep or kill, budget moves, and 3–5 new ad concepts for our patient avatar.



Creative briefs: clear briefs for our video editor so new concepts become live ads within days.

Reporting: one weekly report covering Meta and Google, by campaign: spend, cost per lead, cost per booked call, cost per evaluation and cost per plan of care. Plus a monthly review of what was tested, what was learned and what's next.



Tracking: lead source attribution in our CRM (GoHighLevel) so every lead and patient is tied back to the campaign that produced it.



What Success Looks Like



First 30 days: full audit of Meta, Google and tracking; attribution fixed so every lead has a source; first weekly report and strategy call delivered.

By 90 days: at least [1–2] additional plans of care per month from paid ads, and cost per plan of care reduced by [X%] from baseline; a clear recommendation on how to split budget between Meta and Google.

Every week: report delivered, strategy call held, new ad concepts briefed and tested.



Requirements

4+ years managing both Meta and Google Ads.

Have managed accounts spending $10,000+ USD per month.

Experience with US local service businesses; healthcare, clinics, physical therapy, chiropractic, med spa or fitness strongly preferred.



Can share a real cost per booked appointment from a clinic or local service account you've run.

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience with tracking and attribution.

Excellent written and spoken English.



Working Terms

About 20 hours per week, on your own schedule; heavier during the first month (audit and setup).

Reply to messages within 4 hours, same business day.

Weekly strategy call at a fixed time: [Monday 4:00–5:00 PM Arizona time = Tuesday 7:00–8:00 AM Manila time].

All ad accounts and assets remain owned by CANAM; you'll be added as a user.

No concurrent work for other chiropractic, physical therapy or sports medicine clinics in the Phoenix, Arizona area.



Compensation

1,000–1,700 USD/month, based on experience, paid on the 1st and 15th.

Independent contractor.

Path to full-time as ad spend grows.



How to Apply



Applications without all three items will not be reviewed.

Answer these questions:

What was the cost per booked appointment on the best local-service account you've managed, and what was the monthly budget?

How many years have you managed Meta and Google Ads, each?

Record a Loom video of 5 minutes or less walking through an ad account you've managed: what you changed and what happened.



Send your answers and the Loom link through OnlineJobs.ph or 
 with the subject line "Senior Media Buyer Application."



Finalists will complete a short paid test project: an audit of one of our live campaigns with your top 3 recommendations, plus 5 ad concepts for our patient avatar.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Specialist – Healthcare Vendor Relations
description:
Senior Accounts Payable Specialist – Healthcare Vendor Relations



*Location:* Remote (Philippines)



*Industry:* U.S. Healthcare / Nursing Home Operations



*Experience Level:* Senior / Highly Experienced



### About the Role



We are hiring an experienced *Accounts Payable Specialist* to support a growing U.S.-based nursing home organization.



This is not a traditional invoice-processing position. We need someone who understands accounts payable but, more importantly, knows how to manage vendors, navigate challenging payment situations, negotiate arrangements, and maintain strong business relationships.



Our organization operates in a fast-paced healthcare environment where cash flow fluctuates throughout the month. You'll work closely with the Controller, ownership, and the AP team to help prioritize payments, communicate with vendors, and ensure essential services continue without unnecessary interruptions.



We are looking for someone with excellent judgment, strong communication skills, and the confidence to handle difficult conversations professionally.



### Key Responsibilities



*Vendor Relations & Negotiation*

- Serve as a primary point of contact for vendors regarding outstanding balances, payment schedules, and account issues.

- Negotiate payment arrangements and extensions while maintaining positive vendor relationships.

- Professionally manage vendors who are frustrated about delayed payments.

- Help resolve disputes and prevent interruptions to essential goods and services.

- Recognize when a vendor relationship is at risk and proactively escalate concerns.

- Act as a liaison between vendors, the Controller, and company ownership.



*Cash Flow & Payment Coordination*

- Work closely with management to understand available cash flow and payment priorities.

- Help develop and maintain vendor payment schedules based on approved priorities.

- Identify which vendors require immediate attention and which payments may be negotiated or deferred.

- Maintain accurate records of payment commitments, deadlines, and negotiated arrangements.

- Present practical recommendations to management for resolving competing payment demands.

- Follow management approval procedures. Final payment authorization remains with company leadership.



*Accounts Payable Operations*

- Review invoices, vendor statements, and outstanding balances.

- Support accurate expense coding and reconciliation.

- Maintain organized AP records and aging reports.

- Assist with month-end accounting activities.

- Coordinate with existing AP team members to maintain accurate financial information.



### Qualifications



*Required:*

- Extensive hands-on experience in accounts payable, ideally 7–10+ years.

- Strong experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating payment arrangements.

- Experience working in an environment with fluctuating cash flow and competing payment priorities.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong understanding of AP processes, invoice coding, reconciliations, and month-end procedures.

- Ability to remain calm, professional, and assertive during difficult conversations.

- Excellent organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

- Confidence communicating directly with U.S.-based vendors and senior management.



*Strongly Preferred:*

- Previous experience in U.S. healthcare, particularly nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, long-term care, or home healthcare.

- Experience managing overdue vendor accounts and preventing service interruptions.

- Experience coordinating payment plans across multiple vendors or facilities.



### Who We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Has dealt with difficult vendors and knows how to find solutions.

- Can be diplomatic without being a pushover.

- Understands how to prioritize competing needs when cash is limited.

- Anticipates problems rather than simply reacting to them.

- Knows when to resolve an issue independently and when management needs to get involved.

- Can think strategically while paying attention to accounting details.

- Is resourceful, proactive, emotionally intelligent, and comfortable operating in a demanding environment.



*We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to data entry, invoice processing, or routine bookkeeping.*



We need someone who has experienced the real-world complexities of accounts payable and knows how to navigate them.



### Application Instructions



To be considered, please answer the following questions in your application.



*1. Healthcare Experience*



Have you worked in accounts payable for a U.S. nursing home, healthcare facility, home healthcare company, or similar healthcare organization? Describe your experience and responsibilities.



*2. Vendor Negotiation Experience*



Describe a real situation where a vendor was threatening to stop providing goods or services because of overdue payments. What did you personally do to resolve the situation, and what was the outcome?



*3. Cash-Flow Management Scenario*



Imagine your company owes three vendors money, but there is only enough cash available to pay one of them immediately. All three are demanding payment, and one is threatening to suspend an essential service.



How would you approach this situation? Explain how you would communicate with the vendors, coordinate with management, and develop a plan.



*4. Independent Judgment*



Tell us about a time you successfully managed a difficult vendor relationship without needing step-by-step instructions from your supervisor.



*5. Experience & Availability*



How many years have you worked in accounts payable? What accounting software have you used? What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and what hours are you available to work?



Please provide specific examples from your professional experience rather than generic or AI-generated answers.



We are looking for a long-term team member who can become a trusted partner to our accounting leadership.

title: HVAC Dispatcher for US Home-Service Company | 4 AM to 12 noon PHT, Tue to Sat | $6 to $8/hr
description:
LA Heating & Air Conditioning is a family-owned heating and air conditioning company in Los Angeles, California, in business since 2010. We install and repair heat pumps, air conditioners and furnaces for homes and businesses. We are growing and need a long-term, reliable dispatcher to be the friendly, organized voice of our company. You will be the first voice our customers hear.



PAY

- $6 to $8 USD per hour, depending on experience and interview results

- 40 hours per week, 52 weeks a year

- Paid in USD through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay every week, on time, every time. All pay goes through EasyPay only. We will never ask you to pay anything to apply or to work for us.



YOUR SCHEDULE (Philippine time)

- Tuesday to Saturday, 4:00 AM to 12:00 noon PHT. This is Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM California time.

- California changes its clocks twice a year. From mid-March to early November your shift is 3:00 AM to 11:00 AM PHT. The rest of the year it is 4:00 AM to 12:00 noon PHT. Same days all year.

- This is a fixed schedule. Please apply only if you can work these exact hours every week.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer incoming calls from homeowners and business customers

- Book service calls and estimate visits in Housecall Pro

- Schedule and reschedule our technicians and keep the daily schedule running smoothly

- Follow up with customers on open estimates

- Send customers payment links (you will never take card numbers over the phone)



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years dispatching field technicians for a US home-service company (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest control) (REQUIRED). This is not an entry-level position.

- Experience managing several technicians' schedules at once, handling delays, reschedules and emergency calls in real time

- We value staying with one client a long time

- Excellent spoken and written English with a calm, warm phone manner

- Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan experience preferred

- Spanish is nice to have, not required

- Quiet, dedicated workspace and a noise-canceling headset

- Wired internet of at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload

- Backup internet (second provider or mobile hotspot) AND backup power (UPS or generator), so a brownout does not stop your shift

To show us you read this far, start your application with the words COOL BREEZE.



HOW TO APPLY

Include ALL of the following in your application message. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

1. Your resume (a link, or paste it), showing how long you stayed with each client and why you left

2. A link to a 1 to 2 minute voice recording (Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar, set to "anyone with the link") where you answer this call as our dispatcher: "Hi, my AC stopped working and it's 100 degrees in my house. Can someone come out today?"

3. Short answers to these questions:

   a. How many technicians did you dispatch daily?

   b. What dispatching software or tools have you used?

   c. A technician is running late and the customer is upset. What do you do?

4. Confirmation that you can work Tuesday to Saturday, 4:00 AM to 12:00 noon Philippine time

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD

We will check your internet speed and backup internet and power at the interview stage.

Please write your application yourself. Copy-paste or AI-written applications will not be considered.



OUR SELECTION PROCESS

1. Application review

2. Short paid skills test (about 1 hour, paid at your asking rate): typing test, a written customer
, and booking a sample job from a call transcript

3. 30-minute Zoom interview with camera on, including a role-play with an upset customer

4. Reference check with at least 2 past US clients or supervisors, plus NBI clearance

5. Paid trial of 1 to 2 weeks working real shifts



ABOUT THE POSITION

- Long-term, work-from-home role as an independent contractor under a written contractor agreement

- You provide your own computer, headset and internet, and you handle your own taxes

- Your own Housecall Pro login and calls through our business phone app on your computer

- Hours tracked with Timeproof (free through OnlineJobs.ph) or Hubstaff

- Calls may be recorded for quality and training



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months. If that is you, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Phone Sales Rep (GoHighLevel): Sell Marketing Services to US Home Service Businesses, Part Time Growing to Full Time
description:
We sell a monthly marketing service to local home service businesses in the US (tree service, HVAC, septic, chimney, pest control, garage doors, and similar trades). The service is built on GoHighLevel and helps owners stop losing jobs: a text goes back automatically when they miss a call, reviews get requested after every job, past customers get reactivated, and their website converts visitors into calls. It's $297 a month with no contract.



Each business already has a free listing on our online directory. You call to confirm the listing, book a 10 minute walkthrough, and on that walkthrough sell the service.



This is a phone sales role. Booking the walkthrough is step one. Closing on the walkthrough is the job. You will follow a detailed script and work entirely inside GoHighLevel. If you have never been inside GoHighLevel, please do not apply.



SCHEDULE (2 days a week to start, 16 hours)

You start on Tuesday and Thursday. Wednesday is added when call volume supports it, and more days after that. Our goal is to grow this role into full time. You must keep Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday open so we can add a day without a conflict. You will always get at least a week's notice before any schedule change.



Each shift is 10:00 am to 6:30 pm US Eastern Time:

- 10:00 am to 12:00 pm: calling

- 12:00 to 12:15 pm: break (paid)

- 12:15 to 2:00 pm: calling

- 2:00 to 2:30 pm: lunch (unpaid)

- 2:30 to 5:00 pm: calling

- 5:00 to 5:15 pm: break (paid)

- 5:15 to 6:30 pm: calling



In the Philippines this is a night shift: about 11:00 pm to 7:30 am Manila time from November to March, and one hour earlier from March to November.



PAY

$6 an hour base plus commission. Paid weekly. The first week is a paid trial at the full rate.

- $40 for every business that signs up for the $297 per month service

- $25 for every $349 per year Top Spot listing sold

- $15 for every $149 per year Premium listing sold

Starting at 16 hours a week, moving up to full-time as the business grows. Good closers earn more.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL

- Missed call text back: when the owner can't pick up, the caller gets a text within seconds so the job isn't lost.

- Review generation: automatic review requests after every job.

- Customer reactivation: texts to past customers to bring back repeat work.

- A lead-converting website with click-to-call and quote forms.

- Included free: the top spot in their trade and town on our directory.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call business owners from a GoHighLevel smart list using the browser dialer, starting with their free directory listing.

- Confirm each business's phone, service area, website, and owner name, and update the contact as you talk.

- Offer to verify their listing, and read a text consent question word for word before anything is texted.

- Book 10-minute walkthrough calls on a GoHighLevel calendar.

- Run the walkthroughs: text the owner their report, go through their reviews, Google profile, website, and a missed call calculator with their own numbers, then offer the $297 service and, if they're not ready, a paid directory listing.

- Stay on the line while the owner pays through a link you text them. You never take card numbers.

- Call businesses to pass along quote requests from homeowners who found them on the directory.

- Handle objections calmly using our script, and set callbacks and follow-ups.

- Log every call: notes, tags, custom fields, pipeline stages, tasks, and calendar bookings in GoHighLevel.

- Follow US calling rules: calling hours, call recording notice, do not call requests, and text consent.



REQUIRED

- At least 1 year of outbound cold calling for US clients, including closing sales over the phone, not only booking appointments.

- At least 6 months of hands-on GoHighLevel experience. You should already know how to call from the dialer, work from smart lists, update custom fields and tags, move opportunities between pipeline stages, book appointments on calendars, create tasks, add notes, and insert text snippets in Conversations.

- Clear, natural English that US business owners understand easily. Neutral accent preferred.

- Able to follow a script word for word where required, and sound friendly and natural doing it.

- Computer with Google Chrome, a USB or Bluetooth headset with a mic, a quiet room, and stable internet (plus a backup).

- Available every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday for the full schedule above.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience selling to contractors or home service businesses.

- Experience selling software, marketing, or any monthly subscription over the phone.



HOW WE WORK

- You get a complete written script, the walkthrough flow, and a short readiness quiz before your first call.

- This is a friendly, low-pressure sale. Your job is to leave every call with the listing confirmed and a reason to follow up, and to close the ones who are ready.

- Your calls are recorded and reviewed so we can help you close more.

- Paid trial week first, at the full rate. If it's a good fit, this is a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word HOMEPRO.



2. Send a link to a voice recording (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or similar) of you reading these three lines naturally, as if on a real call:



"Hi, is this Mike? Mike, it's [your name] over at Local Pro Directory. I was calling to let you know that your tree service has a free listing in our Camp Hill directory. The listing allows homeowners to request quotes through it, so I'm on a quick recorded call to make sure the info is correct. Do you have a minute?"



"To send you those quote alerts, I need your consent. Is it OK to text you at the number you provided regarding your listing and quote requests? Message and data rates may apply, and you can reply STOP anytime."



"Totally fair. This isn't a website pitch, and there's no contract. It's $297 a month, cancel anytime, and the missed call tool alone usually pays for it in one job. Want me to set it up while we're on?"



3. In 3 to 5 sentences, describe your cold calling and closing experience: what you sold, to whom, and roughly how many sales you closed in a typical month.



4. In 2 to 3 sentences, describe what you have done in GoHighLevel and for which kind of business. A screenshot of a pipeline or calendar you managed is a plus.



5. Confirm you can work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, 10:00 am to 6:30 pm US Eastern.

title: Civil Designer-Grading
description:
We are hiring a Civil Designer with a civil engineering background and a grading focus. The designer prepares and quality-checks the grading and drainage sheets in our submittals, working from direction given by the Senior Civil Engineer and staff engineers. This role does not sign or stamp documents. Engineering judgment, code interpretation, and final design decisions stay with the engineer of record.



Responsibilities

Prepare precise and rough grading plans in Civil 3D from engineer markups and the project’s approved Design Basis Memo . This includes pad and finished floor elevations, spot elevations, flowlines, swales, slopes, and drainage patterns away from structures.

Build and maintain existing and proposed surfaces, grading feature lines, profiles, and sections. Run surface analyses (slope, elevation, and drainage direction) to confirm the design matches the engineer’s intent before sheets go to review.

Generate cut/fill earthwork quantities and volume surfaces for the engineer to review. Report any imbalance, along with its source, in writing.

Prepare the drainage, erosion control, and BMP sheets that go with the grading set. This covers area drains, inlets, pipe runs, outlet protection, and the BMP exhibits and details for WQMP/SWQMP packages under the applicable regional manual. The designer prepares the erosion control and SWPPP BMP sheets. A QSD prepares and signs the SWPPP.

Coordinate retaining wall top and bottom elevations, setbacks from slopes, and site wall locations with the grading design and the geotechnical report recommendations.

Incorporate plan-check redlines and support the comment response matrix for each resubmittal.

Perform a drafting QC pass before every submittal using the firm checklist. The pass covers spot elevations and flowline continuity, callouts, standard drawing references, sheet index, scales, legends, general and grading notes, and consistency across sheets.

Maintain CAD templates, blocks, the grading details library, and sheet-set standards.

Flag in writing any conflict between an engineer’s markup and the California Building Code, the geotechnical report, or a jurisdiction’s grading standards. Escalate the conflict rather than resolving it independently.

Provide a daily written status update and keep questions and decisions documented in the project folder.

Support staff engineers by answering grading, drafting, and standards questions and explaining what each jurisdiction expects to see on a grading sheet, in sessions scheduled by mutual agreement.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.

Five or more years of civil and land development design experience, with at least three years focused on grading. You must provide a portfolio that includes California grading permit sets.

Advanced Civil 3D proficiency, including surfaces, feature lines, grading groups, profiles, sections, volume surfaces, sheet sets, and xrefs.

Working knowledge of California grading practice:

Grading: CBC Chapter 18 and Appendix J, local grading ordinances, slope and setback requirements, and minimum drainage gradients for pads, hardscape, and swales.

Geotechnical coordination: reading a soils report and carrying its grading recommendations into the plans, including overexcavation limits, slope setbacks, and drainage requirements.

Hydrology and drainage: county hydrology manual conventions and how the drainage design ties into the grading.

Stormwater: regional WQMP/SWQMP requirements as they affect grading and BMP placement.

Erosion control: the Construction General Permit.

Standards: Greenbook, SDRSD, Caltrans, and city standard drawings.

Accessibility: CBC Chapter 11B grading constraints, including path-of-travel slopes and cross slopes.

Direct experience with grading plan-check cycles in Southern California jurisdictions.

Clear written English and reliable availability for at least four hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours.

Successful completion of a paid practical screening exercise. The exercise is a grading sheet prepared from a sample survey and engineer markup.

Preferred Qualifications

Philippine civil engineering license or a comparable credential.

Experience with grading packages for ADUs, single-family residences, and small hillside lots.

Experience coordinating retaining walls with grading on sloped sites.

Bluebeam Revu proficiency.

Familiarity with hydrology and hydraulic calculation tools.

title: Podcast, Social Media & Book Launch Coordinator
description:
I’m a personal trainer, author, and Christian wellness entrepreneur preparing to launch my new book, Move for Joy, on January 27, 2027.



Move for Joy is a faith-based fitness book designed to help women break the exhausting cycle of starting and stopping exercise by shifting the focus from discipline and perfection to motivation, sustainability, and joy.



I’m looking for a highly organized, proactive Podcast, Social Media & Book Launch Coordinator to help me build and run a podcast interview campaign before and after the launch, and to keep my social media consistent and engaging throughout.



This is a great opportunity for someone who loves podcasts and social media, understands women’s wellness and/or Christian audiences, and enjoys making things happen behind the scenes.



What You’ll Do



Podcast Research & Outreach



-Research podcasts that align with Move for Joy and its target audience

-Build and maintain a database of approximately 50–75 relevant podcasts

-Identify podcast hosts, contact information, audience focus, and potential interview topics

-Prioritize high-fit shows rather than simply focusing on podcast size

-Personalize and send podcast pitches

-Track outreach, follow-ups, responses, bookings, and air dates

-Follow up with podcast hosts at appropriate intervals

-Identify new podcast opportunities throughout the campaign



Podcast Booking & Coordination



-Communicate with podcast hosts and producers

-Coordinate interview dates and times

-Send hosts the appropriate bio, headshot, book information, talking points, and links

-Make sure hosts have everything they need before recording

-Maintain an up-to-date podcast calendar

-Keep me informed about upcoming interviews and deadlines

-Help coordinate a concentrated group of podcast appearances around the January 27 launch



Social Media Content & Posting



-Create and post 3 social media posts per week on [Instagram /
 ]

-Design graphics in Canva or use Claude using my brand colors, fonts, and templates

-Write captions in my voice: warm, encouraging, faith-centered, and focused on joy over perfection

-Plan a mix of content: book teasers, launch countdowns, quotes, fitness encouragement, podcast appearances, and behind-the-scenes moments

-Turn podcast episodes into posts (quote graphics, short clips, “listen now” announcements) using Descript

-Keep a simple content calendar and send me each week’s posts for approval at least a few days ahead

-Schedule posts using a scheduling tool, or post them directly

-Track basic engagement and share what’s resonating



Launch Promotion



Help turn podcast appearances into promotional content by:



-Tracking when episodes go live

-Providing me with a weekly list of upcoming podcast appearances

-Gathering episode links and graphics from hosts

-Creating a promotional schedule for social media and

-Identifying strong quotes or clips that could be repurposed

-Helping coordinate a “podcast week” around the book launch



Campaign Timeline



November–December



-Build podcast database

-Research target audiences

-Develop outreach system and tracking spreadsheet

-Finalize pitch materials

-Set up the social media content calendar and Canva templates

-Conduct primary podcast outreach

-Send approximately 10–15 personalized pitches per week

-Follow up with potential hosts

-Schedule and coordinate interviews

-Post 3x per week, building anticipation for the book



December–January



-Coordinate recordings

-Prepare hosts with interview materials

-Confirm launch-related episode timing

-Build the launch-week podcast schedule

-Ramp up launch countdown content on social media



January 27, 2027



-Book launch

-Coordinate concentrated podcast and social media promotion around launch week



February



-Continue podcast outreach

-Promote newly released episodes on social media

-Pursue additional opportunities based on launch momentum



What I’m Looking For



You are:



-Extremely organized and detail-oriented

-A strong written communicator

-Comfortable writing personalized outreach
s and engaging social media captions

-Proactive: you don’t need to be told what to do at every step

-Comfortable researching podcasts and identifying good audience fits

-Experienced with social media content creation using Canva, Descript, and Claude. 

-Familiar with Google Sheets, Gmail, and basic project-management tools

-Comfortable communicating professionally with podcast hosts

-Interested in women’s health, fitness, wellness, faith, or personal development

-Able to keep track of many moving pieces without dropping details



Bonus Skills



You don’t need all of these, but they’re a major plus:



-Previous podcast booking or PR experience

-Experience promoting a book or author

-Experience working with Christian podcasts or women’s podcasts

-Experience with podcast guest outreach

-Experience with social media scheduling tools (Later, Planoly, Meta Business Suite, etc.)

-Experience creating short-form video clips or Reels

-Experience creating launch calendars

-Existing knowledge of podcast research tools or databases



The Ideal Person



I’m not looking for someone who will simply send a generic pitch to hundreds of podcasts or post generic content.



I’m looking for someone who can look at a podcast and say:



“This audience is a great fit for Kasey. Here’s the specific conversation I’d pitch to this host.”



You should be comfortable taking ownership of the process, keeping me organized, and proactively looking for opportunities.



Initial Responsibilities & Goals



The primary goal is to help secure a strong slate of podcast interviews surrounding the January 27 launch, supported by consistent social media.



Success will include:



-50–75 well-researched podcast prospects

-Consistent weekly outreach

-Personalized pitches

-Organized follow-up

-A growing calendar of confirmed interviews

-Several appearances concentrated around launch week

-3 on-brand social media posts published every week

-Continued podcast opportunities in the months following launch



Hours & Compensation



Part-time contract position



Estimated commitment: 5-8 hours per week, increasing slightly around launch.



I’m open to discussing either:



An hourly rate, or

A monthly project rate for the campaign through February



Please include your preferred rate and estimated hours/week in your application.



To Apply



Please send:



-A brief introduction

-Your relevant experience with podcast outreach, PR, book launches, social media, or virtual assistance

-Examples of podcast outreach you’ve done, if applicable

-2–3 examples of social media posts you’ve created (links or screenshots)

-Your hourly or project rate

-Your estimated weekly availability

-Three podcasts you think would be a great fit for Move for Joy and, in 1–2 sentences each, explain why

-A sample subject line you’d use to pitch me as a podcast guest



Please do not send a generic cover letter. I want to see how you think about finding the right audience and creating a compelling pitch.



I’m looking for someone who can begin as soon as possible and stay through the book launch and post-launch campaign.

title: Real-Time Vehicle Dispatch Specialist
description:
We’re hiring our first dedicated Dispatchers to support our growing operations, particularly on a network of autonomous vehicles and food-delivery robots across U.S. markets. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day dispatch including monitoring live fleet operations, coordinating with field teams, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and helping build dispatch workflows that will support the operation as it scales. 



You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.



What You'll Do

- Monitor fleet activity and alert channels across multiple platforms and markets, tracking robot and vehicle locations, battery levels, active tasks, and delivery status.

- Own operational issues through resolution by identifying and prioritizing issues as they arise, including stalled or immobilized robots, unsafe conditions, missed tasks, and deliveries that fall off schedule.

- Contact the assigned field operator to resolve the issue, and follow established escalation procedures when they do not respond within the required timeframe.

- Coordinate backup coverage when the assigned operator is unavailable so that fleet operations continue without interruption.

- Continuously triage incoming alerts, messages, and fleet data, determining what requires immediate action and what can be handled through normal workflows.

- Prioritize and coordinate field service activity across markets, including battery swaps, robot recoveries, fleet interventions, and other service stops.

title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
description:

Chris Corzo Injury Attorneys is a Louisiana personal injury firm helping injured people secure maximum recovery at speed with felt care. We ranked No. 1,592 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 and No. 80 on the 2026 Inc. Regionals: Southeast.



About the role:

Use AI to transform what a law firm can achieve.



Our ambition is to continually expand what CCIA can accomplish while radically reducing the time, cost, and human effort required, wherever that produces greater risk-adjusted long-term profit.



You will study both AI and CCIA, identify the opportunities with the greatest expected impact relative to alternatives, and personally help turn approved priorities into dependable results. Not more AI for its own sake. The most valuable change next.

Deliver: Personally architect, build, integrate, and deploy approved AI solutions, including agentic systems.

Protect: Establish appropriate permissions, evaluations, tests, monitoring, failure recovery, and documentation.

Verify: Work with process owners on adoption and measurable business results; distinguish estimated savings from realized benefit.

Multiply capability: Teach the team, share discoveries, and improve how CCIA develops and operates AI.

The highest-value opportunities move into reliable use. Results are measured, commitments are met, blockers surface early, and systems remain understandable and maintainable.



Who fits:

You are deeply immersed in AI, independently curious, commercially minded, and technically strong. You challenge assumptions, explain clearly, and own results from discovery through sustained use.



Our values: Own the Results; High Achievers; United Around Shared Success; Prudence, Fortitude, & Temperance.



Who will struggle:

Someone who wants only assigned tickets, research without delivery, or impressive demos without dependable operation and business value.

Sound business judgment and clear written and spoken English.



We assess demonstrated capability, not a fixed number of years or a particular degree.



Preferred: Technical leadership, sensitive-data environments, and Filevine, Microsoft 365, or Google Cloud experience.



Compensation:

USD $4,500–$6,500/month, based on demonstrated capability. Exceptional candidates above this range may state their expectations. Final compensation and engagement terms will be agreed in writing.



How to apply:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “CCIA Principal AI,” your resume, and one relevant work sample or sanitized case study. Complete the survey linked above and answer:

title: Senior Shopify Developer & CRO Specialist (DTC Brands, Paid Social)
description:
SKILLS

Shopify, Shopify Development, Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, GraphQL, Conversion Rate Optimization, A/B Testing, Landing Pages, Google Analytics, Ecommerce, Git, Web Performance



ABOUT US

We run three direct-to-consumer brands on Shopify in Argentina: skincare, a doctor-founded brand and premium cigars. Our growth comes from paid social (Meta and TikTok ads). The stores are in Spanish. We use AI agents (Claude Code) and GitHub every day, so you will work alongside automation, not against it.



THE ROLE

You will own store performance: build it, test it and prove what made more profit. This is a senior role for one person who can both ship code and diagnose conversion problems.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain Shopify OS 2.0 themes (Horizon, North, Dawn) across three stores

- Turn winning ads into product pages, listicles and advertorials with a consistent message from ad to checkout

- Find where the funnel leaks by device, landing page and traffic source, then fix what matters most

- Run A/B tests with a written hypothesis, a sample size and a stopping rule

- Improve bundles, upsells, free shipping thresholds and subscriptions, measured by profit per visitor

- Prepare date-based campaigns (Cyber Monday, Black Friday, Christmas) that switch on and off automatically

- Send a short weekly report: what changed, the result, the decision and what comes next



MUST HAVE: SHOPIFY

- 4+ years building on Shopify, with live stores you can show

- Advanced Liquid, JSON templates, sections, blocks and section groups

- JavaScript, HTML and CSS, including debugging app conflicts and CSS specificity

- Keeping native theme buy buttons working when apps hide or override them

- Shopify CLI, GitHub, draft themes, Theme Check and safe rollbacks

- Admin GraphQL API: metafields, metaobjects, bulk product updates, media uploads and webhooks

- Hands-on experience with bundle, subscription, review, pop-up and
 apps (we use Kaching Bundles, Puentify, Loox, Alia and Klaviyo)

- Mobile speed work: Core Web Vitals, image optimization and removing app bloat

- Pixel-accurate implementation of a Figma file or a reference site, on mobile and desktop



MUST HAVE: CONVERSION

- Proven CRO results on ecommerce stores, with numbers and how you measured them

- Direct-response page structure: headline, offer, proof, objections and guarantee

- Long-form, education-first landing pages, listicles and advertorials

- Customer awareness levels, market sophistication and matching the page to the ad that sent the visitor

- Heatmaps and session recordings (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity or similar)

- A/B testing tools and statistics: sample size, significance and when not to trust a result

- Offer and pricing economics: AOV, contribution margin, break-even ROAS and profit per visitor



MUST HAVE: MEASUREMENT

- Shopify Analytics, GA4 and UTMs

- Meta Pixel and Conversions API, including event deduplication

- Before-and-after analysis by product: units sold, gross profit and AOV

- Excluding major sale dates when judging long-term results



HOW WE WORK

- What is selling does not break. Work goes to a draft theme first, with a backup, mobile QA and a rollback plan.

- Profit beats conversion rate. A test that sells more but earns less is a losing test.

- Only true claims. No fake reviews, fake countdowns, fake scarcity or inflated compare-at prices.

- We have high design standards: clean, premium and specific to each brand, never generic templates.

- You find problems and close them without being chased.

- Clear written English and Loom updates, since most communication is asynchronous.



NICE TO HAVE

- Spanish, or experience working on stores in another language with translation tools

- Experience with AI coding agents

- Mercado Pago or other Latin American payment and shipping setups

- Beauty, health or age-restricted product experience

- Wholesale and retail selling on the same store



SCHEDULE

At least 4 hours per day must overlap with Argentina business hours: 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM in Argentina is 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM in the Philippines. Extra availability around major sale dates will be agreed in advance.



HOW TO APPLY

We only review applications that include all of the following:

1. Start your application with: PROFIT FIRST

2. Links to 3 Shopify stores you personally worked on, what you did on each, the result in numbers and how you measured it

3. A Loom video of up to 5 minutes reviewing any Shopify product page on mobile: the 3 changes you would make first, why, and how you would measure each one

4. Your answer to this: a new bundle raises conversion rate by 12% but lowers profit per order by 20%. Do you keep it? Show your math.

5. Your expected monthly salary and the hours you can work

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, persistent, and relationship-driven Follow-Up Specialist to manage and nurture inbound seller leads.



In this role, you'll take ownership of the lead follow-up process, ensuring every inquiry receives timely attention and no potential opportunity gets lost in the pipeline.



You'll serve as the bridge between inbound leads and the acquisitions team, building meaningful connections with prospective sellers through consistent, personalized, and empathetic communication.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, thrives in a high-volume environment, and understands that successful follow-up requires both persistence and genuine relationship-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Lead Response & Management

- Contact every new inbound lead within 10 minutes of receiving an inquiry, primarily through phone calls.

- Make multiple contact attempts throughout the day for leads that have not yet been reached.

- Prioritize new inquiries to ensure timely engagement and prevent missed opportunities.

- Record all calls, conversations, and follow-up activities in the CRM.

2. Daily Lead Follow-Up & Campaign Management

- Work through prioritized lead lists daily, following the established urgency and contact cadence.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules across different lead stages:

  - Recent leads (0–7 days): 3–5 contact attempts per week.

  - Leads (8–30 days): 2–3 contact attempts per week.

  - Older leads (1–6 months and 6+ months): Maintain regular follow-up campaigns.

- Review and work through missed follow-up tasks at least once every two weeks.

- Alternate between dialer campaigns and click-to-call strategies to maximize contact and answer rates.

3. Relationship Building & Communication

- Build rapport with prospective sellers through genuine, empathetic, and conversational interactions.

- Understand each seller's circumstances, which may include divorce, foreclosure, inherited properties, or financial challenges.

- Personalize conversations based on each lead's situation rather than relying solely on scripted communication.

- Follow up through phone calls, text messages, and
s when prospects are unavailable.

4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records after every interaction, including notes, lead status, and next follow-up dates.

- Track qualified leads successfully passed to the acquisitions team.

- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates on lead conversions.

- Identify recurring patterns, opportunities, and challenges, and communicate relevant insights to leadership.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent phone communication skills with a warm, confident, and natural conversational style.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage a high-volume follow-up pipeline.

- High levels of discipline, accountability, and consistency.

- Strong emotional intelligence and empathy when dealing with sellers in sensitive or challenging situations.

- Persistent and proactive, without being overly aggressive or pushy.

- Excellent written communication skills, particularly for personalized text messages and
s.

- Comfortable making a high volume of daily calls.

- Strong attention to detail, especially in CRM documentation and data management.

- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in outbound calling, inside sales, lead management, appointment setting, or customer service.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, particularly Podio.

- Experience using auto-dialers or power dialers, such as BatchDialer.

- Background in real estate, property management, or sales-driven environments is an advantage.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

- Familiarity with team communication tools such as Slack.

No real estate experience? That's okay! Full training on processes, systems, and workflows will be provided. We're more interested in your willingness to learn, adaptability, and ability to follow through.



Tools & Platforms

- CRM: Podio

- Auto-Dialer: BatchDialer or similar power dialer

- Communication: Slack

- Productivity Tools: Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel



How Success Is Measured

- Lead Response Time: New inbound leads contacted within 10 minutes.

- Follow-Up Completion: 100% of scheduled follow-up tasks completed on time.

- Campaign Pass Rate: Number of qualified leads successfully handed off to the acquisitions team.

- Contact Rate: Percentage of leads successfully reached through outreach efforts.

WE'RE NOT LOOKING TO FILL SEATS. WE'RE LOOKING FOR CLOSERS WHO PRODUCE.



If you have the experience, discipline, and hunger to earn, APPLY NOW.



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS:



1. Daily Call Volume

In your most recent phone sales role, how many outbound calls did you average per day? Are you comfortable making 200+ calls daily?



2. One-Call Closing Experience

Were you personally responsible for closing the sale AND collecting payment on the initial call? What were you selling, and what was your average sale amount?



3. U.S. Sales Experience

Describe your experience selling directly to U.S. customers. What products or services did you sell?



4. Commission-Only Compensation

This is a 100% commission position with NO base salary or hourly pay. Warm leads are provided, and commissions are uncapped. Are you fully comfortable with this structure?

title: GHL Sales Closer ( Sharks ONLY)
description:
Wanted: Sharks. Not Goldfish.

We eat what we kill. If you need someone to hold your hand, motivate you every morning, or explain the same thing twice, close this tab now. We are hiring remote Sales Closers who read the SOP, log into GoHighLevel, call business owners and get to work. You get the lead lists, proven scripts, training and coaching. Your only job is to turn conversations into paying clients.



About Us

We're a fast-growing, U.S.-based business services company helping business owners nationwide with tax and bookkeeping, commercial cleaning and business credit. We're building our outbound sales team and need confident closers who open conversations and turn them into paying clients. We move fast, we run on systems, and we reward people who produce.



The Role

You call business owners nationwide and sell three services:

• Tax and bookkeeping B2B

• Commercial cleaning B2B

• Credit & Debt Management B2B



You open the conversation, qualify the prospect, present the package and close the sale. Top closers move up to Senior 



Closer and Team Lead. (2 Positions OPEN)

Flex Time, 2-6 hours a day, fully remote, working U.S. business hours.



What You'll Do Every Day

1. Log in on time, clock in on Trackabi, and check your GHL pipeline and PM tasks.

2. Call business owners from our lead lists through the GHL dialer using our proven scripts.

3. Qualify prospects, present our service packages, close the sale and collect payment through the GHL checkout.

4. Book and run follow-up calls with prospects who need more time.

5. Handle objections with confidence — no freelancing the offer or the pricing.

6. Log every call, note and outcome in GHL before you move on: disposition, tags, pipeline stage, next task.

7. Confirm every booked call and closed deal with the admin team by phone,
 or SMS 

8. Log your time and leave notes on your Upbase tasks before you clock out.



Must-Haves

• Proven sales results. 2+ year of outbound sales, closing or cold calling. Bring numbers, not adjectives.

• GoHighLevel experience. You already know the dialer, Conversations, pipelines, calendars, tags and tasks. We will not teach you GHL from zero.

• You read the SOP first. Every process is written down. You read it, follow it, and only ask questions the SOP doesn't answer.

• Clear spoken English and a friendly, confident phone voice. You follow a script and still sound natural.

• Commission-driven. Self-motivated and coachable — you hit your numbers without being chased.

• Reliable setup. Stable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset and a backup plan for power and internet.



Bonus: B2B sales, or tax, accounting, cleaning or credit sales experience.



Tools You'll Live In

GoHighLevel:  Dialer, SMS,
, pipelines, calendars, checkout

Upbase: Tasks, projects and notes

Desktop Trackeri: Time tracking — every hour logged accurately

Microsoft 365 company



Zoom

Sales calls, team meetings and training

VA Hub / offline pm software

Team updates and admin confirmations

Your Numbers:  You are measured on output, every day and every month.

Target Minimum

Daily dials: 150

Paid clients per month: 10+ (unlocks the monthly kicker)

CRM updates: 100% of calls logged in GHL same day

Admin confirmation: Every booked call and closed deal

Hit your numbers and you unlock more leads, bigger bonuses and raises. 

Miss them two weeks in a row and we have a conversation.



Pay & Rewards

Base pay keeps the lights on. Commission is where sharks eat.

• Base: $4.00/hr, flex-time, up to 6 hours a day 

• Show bonus: $1.50 for every booked call that shows.

• Monthly kicker: 10+ paid clients in a month = an extra $45

• Bonuses are paid bi-weekly via Remitly once the client's payment clears.

Closed-deal bonus — for every client you close who pays:



Deal size.            Bonus per paid client

$50 -  $150:        $5

$150–$499:        $15

$500–$1,999:     $25

$2,000+:              $55



Raise Path 

When.                 Base pay.   What it takes

65 days               $4.25/hr     Steady attendance and hitting closing targets

120 days             $5.00/hr.     Consistent top closer



Ongoing



Senior Closer, Team Lead

Top performers earn bigger bonuses and leadership roles

Scripts, training and coaching are provided.



Do NOT Apply If

• You need daily motivation to pick up the phone.

• You skip the SOP and ask questions it already answers.

• You have never used GoHighLevel.

• You don't log your time or leave notes.

• You disappear for days without a word.

• You want a paycheck for showing up instead of producing.



How to Apply

This is your first test. Follow every step or your application is deleted.

1. Put "I EAT WHAT I KILL" as the first line of your application.

2. Send a short voice note introducing yourself plus a 30-second sample pitch — sell us like you're closing a business owner.

3. Share your best sales numbers: dials per day, close rate, biggest month.

4. Use at least 10 Connects when applying.

Shortlisted candidates complete a live role-play interview on Zoom and submit their details in our app. Our admin team confirms every interview by phone,
 or SMS and sends your Zoom link.

title: SEO Project Manager – Content Optimization & Implementation
description:
Job Type: Ongoing / Long-Term Opportunity

Experience Level: Intermediate to Expert

Industry: Digital Marketing / SEO

Project Management Platform: Asana

About the Role: We are a growing SEO agency seeking an experienced, detail-oriented SEO Project Manager to oversee and coordinate content optimization projects across a diverse portfolio of clients.



This is a hands-on project management role that combines SEO knowledge, content optimization, workflow coordination, and quality assurance.



We already have established SEO strategies, optimization processes, AI prompts, and software tools in place. We are looking for someone who can take these existing resources, execute the optimization workflow, and ensure recommendations are properly implemented across client websites.



You will not be expected to build SEO strategies from scratch. Instead, your primary responsibility will be to manage the execution of our existing processes, maintain quality standards, and keep projects moving efficiently.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working independently, understands on-page SEO best practices, and can confidently coordinate with developers and other team members.

Key Responsibilities1. Content Optimization & Recommendations





Utilize our pre-developed AI prompts, SEO tools, and established workflows to generate content optimization recommendations.

Review existing website pages and identify opportunities to improve SEO performance.

Develop and organize recommendations for page titles, meta descriptions, headings, keyword targeting, internal linking, content structure, and other on-page elements.

Ensure recommendations align with established SEO strategies and client-specific requirements.

Review AI-generated recommendations for accuracy, relevance, quality, and consistency.

Prepare clear, actionable optimization instructions for implementation.



2. Project Management & Asana Coordination



Manage content optimization projects from initial assignment through final implementation and quality assurance.

Create, organize, assign, and maintain tasks within Asana.

Track project deadlines, deliverables, and completion status.

Coordinate workloads across multiple clients and projects simultaneously.

Ensure tasks contain clear instructions, supporting documentation, and necessary resources.

Proactively identify delays, roadblocks, and opportunities to improve efficiency.



3. Developer Coordination & Implementation



Assign approved content optimization recommendations to the appropriate developers for implementation.

Provide clear instructions to ensure developers understand the requested changes.

Monitor implementation progress and follow up on outstanding tasks.

Review completed work to verify that recommendations were implemented correctly.

When appropriate and within your technical capabilities, directly implement optimizations within WordPress or other CMS platforms.

Escalate technical issues or implementation challenges when necessary.



4. Quality Assurance & Reporting



Conduct quality checks on optimization recommendations before implementation.

Verify that completed website updates match approved recommendations.

Check formatting, metadata, heading structures, internal links, and overall page presentation.

Maintain accurate project records and task statuses in Asana.

Provide regular progress updates to agency leadership.

Help identify recurring workflow challenges and recommend process improvements.

Required Qualifications

Previous experience in SEO project management, SEO operations, or content optimization.

Solid understanding of on-page SEO fundamentals and best practices.

Strong experience using Asana or a comparable project management platform.

Familiarity with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, or similar platforms.

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with content development and optimization.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines without extensive supervision.

Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail.

Comfortable coordinating with developers and reviewing website updates.

Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to project management.

Preferred Qualifications



Experience working within an SEO or digital marketing agency.

Familiarity with WordPress, Elementor, Webflow, Wix, or similar CMS platforms.

Ability to implement basic on-page SEO changes independently.

Experience managing offshore or remote development teams.

Understanding of technical SEO fundamentals.

Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.

Experience creating or improving standard operating procedures (SOPs).

What Success Looks Like:

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the optimization process and ensure projects move from recommendation to implementation with minimal oversight.



Success in this role means:



Content optimization projects are consistently completed on time.

Asana tasks are organized, accurate, and regularly updated.

Recommendations are high-quality, actionable, and aligned with SEO best practices.

Developers receive clear instructions and have what they need to complete assignments.

Completed optimizations are reviewed for accuracy before being marked complete.

Leadership has visibility into project progress without needing to constantly request updates.

Processes become more efficient as you become familiar with our workflows.

Opportunity for Growth



This is intended to be an ongoing role with the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as our agency grows.



Candidates who demonstrate strong SEO knowledge, technical capabilities, and the ability to manage projects independently may have opportunities to expand into broader SEO operations, implementation, and team management.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your proposal:



A brief overview of your experience managing SEO or content optimization projects.

Your experience using Asana to manage workflows and coordinate team members.

The SEO tools and CMS platforms you are comfortable working with.

Whether you have experience directly implementing on-page SEO recommendations.

An example of how you've managed multiple SEO projects or coordinated with developers.



We are looking for someone who is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of taking ownership of an established process while helping us improve it over time.

title: Sales & Marketing Manager (CRM & Community Outreach) – Remote
description:
Sales & Marketing Manager (CRM & Community Outreach) – Remote



Company: Boarding & Beyond – Dog Daycare, Boarding & Grooming

Location: Remote 

Schedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | U.S. Mountain Time

Compensation: $4,000 USD/Month (Base + Performance Bonuses)

Website: 



Are you already exceptional at sales, customer communication, CRM management, and building relationships? Do you consistently produce results, identify opportunities, and take initiative without needing constant direction?



We're hiring an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to convert inquiries into paying customers, improve sales follow-up, build referral partnerships, and drive business growth.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a technical digital marketing role. You don't need experience managing Google Ads,
 Ads, websites, or advanced CRM automations. Other specialists handle those responsibilities.



We want someone who excels at connecting with people, closing sales, managing customer relationships, and executing practical marketing and outreach strategies.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We're looking for an A player with proven skills, strong judgment, and a history of measurable results. 



We provide the tools, resources, and goals. You bring the expertise, initiative, and ability to execute.





About Boarding & Beyond:

Founded in 1996, Boarding & Beyond has spent 30 years making a difference in the lives of dogs and the families who love them. Located in Aurora, Colorado, USA, we provide dog daycare, boarding, and grooming services.  Our mission is simple: Change dogs' lives for the better while giving pet parents peace of mind. 



We believe exceptional businesses are built by exceptional people. Our culture values customer service, ownership, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.  We're looking for a highly capable professional who wants to make a meaningful contribution to our continued growth.



Your Mission: Generate More Paying Customers



Your primary responsibility will be to help Boarding & Beyond acquire new customers, convert more inquiries into bookings, and increase repeat business.



We already receive inquiries from dog owners interested in our services. Your first priority will be making sure those opportunities turn into paying customers.



Beyond sales conversion, you'll take ownership of customer follow-up, CRM execution, referral generation, local business outreach, and organic marketing initiatives.



You'll be responsible for executing proven strategies, identifying improvements, and producing measurable results.



Your Key Responsibilities



1. Sales & Lead Conversion — Your #1 Priority



- Personally call, text, and
 prospective customers to convert inquiries into bookings.

- Proactively follow up with leads who haven't booked.

- Build rapport, establish trust, handle objections, and close sales.

- Identify missed sales opportunities and recover potential customers.

- Improve sales scripts, follow-up strategies, and booking conversion rates.

- Track leads, sales activity, and conversion performance.

- Take ownership of ensuring qualified opportunities don't get overlooked.



We're looking for someone who is already confident, persuasive, and effective at selling over the phone.



2. CRM Management & Sales Optimization



You'll use GoHighLevel to manage leads, customer communication, follow-up, and sales opportunities.



- Keep CRM records organized, accurate, and actionable.

- Manage sales pipelines and ensure timely follow-up.

- Review recorded customer calls to identify missed sales opportunities and customer service issues.

- Recommend and implement improvements that increase conversions.

- Execute customer follow-up and reactivation campaigns.

- Identify inefficiencies and improve existing CRM processes.

- Monitor and report performance.



We want someone who understands how to use a CRM to generate revenue—not someone who simply enters data.



3. Community Outreach & Referral Partnerships



- Proactively contact veterinarians, apartment communities, pet stores, and other local businesses.

- Develop relationships that generate new customer referrals.

- Confidently make outbound calls, present partnership opportunities, and handle objections.

- Create consistent follow-up processes for potential partners.

- Develop and execute customer referral programs.

- Track which partnerships and campaigns generate paying customers.



You should already be comfortable initiating conversations, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities.



4. Customer Retention & Reactivation



- Reengage inactive customers and encourage repeat bookings.

- Execute targeted
 and SMS campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to increase customer retention.

- Encourage and track customer referrals.

- Improve communication throughout the customer experience.

- Measure campaign results and continuously improve performance.



5. Marketing & Online Community Engagement



- Promote Boarding & Beyond in relevant local
 groups and online communities.

- Identify opportunities to reach local dog owners.

- Create and schedule social media posts using photos and videos we provide.

- Encourage authentic customer reviews and monitor online reputation.

- Execute organic marketing campaigns that generate inquiries and bookings.

- Identify, test, and improve customer acquisition strategies.



Paid advertising, website development, and advanced technical CRM development are handled separately.



Your focus is execution that produces customers and revenue—not marketing activity for its own sake.





Who We're Looking For



We want an experienced, highly capable professional with a demonstrated history of success.



You Must Already Be Strong In:



Sales & Closing

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident, persuasive phone communication with U.S. customers.

- Strong lead follow-up and objection-handling skills.

- A demonstrated ability to convert inquiries into paying customers.

- The ability to independently manage sales conversations from initial contact through booking.



CRM & Customer Relationship Management

- Experience managing leads, pipelines, and follow-up using CRM software.

- Understanding of how to improve sales conversion through effective follow-up.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to recognize sales process problems and recommend practical solutions.



Marketing & Business Development

- Experience executing marketing or customer acquisition initiatives.

- Ability to research prospects, conduct outreach, and develop relationships.

- Understanding of referrals, retention, and customer engagement.

- Ability to measure performance and improve results.



Independent Execution & Ownership

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to prioritize high-impact work without constant supervision.

- Initiative to identify and solve problems independently.

- A track record of reliably completing commitments.

- A genuine desire to improve performance and contribute ideas.





We care far more about demonstrated performance than degrees, certifications, or impressive-sounding job titles.



You don't need to know the pet care industry. But you should already be highly competent in the core sales, communication, CRM, and marketing skills this position requires.





How We Operate



We give our team clear goals, tools, and the opportunity to take ownership. In return, we expect professionalism, accountability, and excellent execution.



Our operating principles are:



- Customer First: Every interaction should create value and build trust.

- Results Over Activity: We measure outcomes, not how busy you are.

- Own the Outcome: Take initiative, solve problems, and follow through.

- Focus on What Matters: Prioritize the work that generates the greatest impact.

- Raise the Standard: Deliver excellent work and continuously improve.

- Move Fast: Execute, measure, learn, and improve.

- Zero Silent Failures: Communicate problems early and bring a recovery plan.

- No Proof = Not Done: Use Asana to document commitments, deadlines, completed work, and results.

- Build Better Systems: Improve processes instead of repeatedly working around problems.



We don't believe great people need to be micromanaged. We believe they need clear expectations, the right tools, and the opportunity to perform.



How Success Is Measured



You'll have a written performance scorecard with clearly defined goals.



Success includes:



- Higher percentages of qualified inquiries converted into paying customers.

- More customers generated through follow-up and reactivation.

- More paying customers from referrals and local partnerships.

- Improved customer retention and repeat bookings.

- Better customer service and sales call quality.

- Accurate CRM management and consistent follow-through.

- Successful execution of marketing initiatives that generate measurable business results.



Your results—not simply your activity—will determine your performance.



Compensation: Exceptional Results Deserve Exceptional Rewards



We believe talented people who create meaningful business results should have the opportunity to earn more.



Monthly Compensation (USD)

- Guaranteed Base Salary: $1,000/month

- On-Target Earnings: $3,000/month total

- Exceptional Performance: Up to $4,000/month total



Performance bonuses are based on agreed-upon, measurable business results. Specific goals, bonus calculations, and eligibility will be established in a written performance scorecard. Bonus earnings are not guaranteed.



Produce more value. Earn more.





How to Apply  

Please submit:  

-Your current resume.  

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.  



We care more about demonstrated performance, initiative, and results than degrees or certifications.
